title: Development of a low-level radio frequency system for remote in situ superconducting radio frequency cavity measurements and calibrations in conduction-cooling systems
summary: We developed a low-level radio frequency (LLRF) system for superconducting radio frequency (SRF) cavity measurements in a conduction-cooling system. A voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) was used in a phase-locked loop (PLL) to track the frequencies of SRF cavity modes. {\tt{Python}}-based software developed in-house controlled and monitored the system. By introducing an additional circulator and associated components, we developed an LLRF system enabling fully remote in situ SRF cavity measurements for the first time. This design also enables remote in situ calibrations. Hence, our LLRF system improves safety through fully remote operation and enhances measurement precision through in situ calibrations, with safety always taking priority. These calibrations are important for measurements in conduction-cooling systems because temperature stability and uniformity in these systems are poorer than those in convection-cooling systems using costly liquid helium and can vary over time and with environmental conditions.

title: Observation of a Förster Resonance in a Heated Rydberg Atom Ensemble
comment: 6 pages with 4 figures, then 5 pages of supplementary material with 4 figures
summary: Rydberg atoms in thermal vapour are of increasing relevance for a range of emerging technologies including compact electric field sensors, where state energies are detected via electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT). However, at increased atomic number densities, the Rydberg EIT response becomes non-linear, resulting in distortion of the spectral lineshape. It is thought that this non-linearity mainly arises due to ionisation, although accurate quantitative modelling of the spectrum and assessment of other physical processes remains challenging. In this work, we address these issues in a combined theoretical and experimental study, constructing a model that accurately reproduces observed EIT spectral profiles. We show from analysis of lineshape shifts that while ionisation accounts for most of the non-linearity, it is also possible to observe Rydberg interaction effects for strongly-coupled states near a Förster resonance.

AI.tldr: 该文结合理论与实验研究热蒸气中Rydberg原子的EIT谱线形非线性，建立可准确复现观测谱线的模型，并表明电离是主要非线性来源，同时在Förster共振附近的强耦合态中可观测到Rydberg相互作用效应。

AI.method: 开展理论与实验相结合的研究，构建能够准确复现实验观测EIT谱线轮廓的模型，并基于谱线线形位移分析区分电离贡献与其他物理效应。摘要未给出具体原子种类、实验参数或模型细节。

title: Site-Resolved Optical Spectroscopy of Thulium in Solid Argon
summary: We utilize the high resolution of the ground state transition ${}^2\mathrm{F}_{7/2} \leftrightarrow {}^2\mathrm{F}_{5/2}$ in thulium atoms isolated in solid argon to perform excitation-emission spectroscopy. Decomposition of the excitation-emission spectrum reveals 6 absorption-emission profiles, which are attributed to multiple trapping sites in the host matrix. Comparison with vacuum transition energies shows large matrix-induced shifts for $\mathrm{s}\rightarrow\mathrm{p}$ transitions, whereas $\mathrm{f} \rightarrow \mathrm{d}$ transitions remain close to their free-atom energies. A single site exhibiting strong emission at 560nm is investigated and a three-photon excitation pathway is determined as a possible origin of the high energy 560nm light. Additionally, for long-lived levels belonging to the $\mathrm{f}^{12}\mathrm{d}$ configuration, narrow, crystal-field split absorption lines are identified. Matrix effects are important for establishing the mechanism behind the observed spectra and long $\mathrm{f}^{12}\mathrm{d}$ lifetimes.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用嵌入固态氩中的铥原子高分辨率基态跃迁开展激发-发射光谱研究，识别出6个吸收-发射轮廓并归因于多个捕获位点；发现s→p跃迁受基质诱导位移较大，而f→d跃迁接近自由原子能量，并探讨了560 nm强发射的可能三光子激发路径及f12d长寿命能级的晶场分裂吸收线。

AI.method: 采用激发-发射光谱法，利用固态氩中铥原子的高分辨率 ^2F7/2 ↔ ^2F5/2 基态跃迁；分解激发-发射谱得到6个吸收-发射轮廓，并与真空跃迁能量比较；针对560 nm强发射的单一位点分析激发路径；同时识别f12d组态长寿命能级的窄晶场分裂吸收线。

title: Angular dependence of the Wigner time delay upon tunnel ionization of CO
summary: We report on Wigner time delays in the strong-field ionization of carbon monoxide. Using co-rotating two-color laser fields (395 and 790 nm), we retrieve time delays that depend on the electron emission direction in the molecular frame, with variations of up to $\pm70$ as. The measured angular dependence agrees with predictions from a simple model based on molecular Ammosov-Delone-Krainov (MO-ADK) theory. Our results demonstrate that the directional dependence of electron emission times in asymmetric molecular potentials can be experimentally accessed in the strong-field regime.

AI.tldr: 利用395 nm与790 nm共旋转双色激光场研究CO强场电离中的Wigner时间延迟，发现延迟随分子坐标系中电子发射方向变化可达±70 as，并与基于MO-ADK的简单模型预测一致，表明强场条件下可实验探测非对称分子势中电子发射时间的方向依赖。
AI.motivation: 研究一氧化碳强场电离中的Wigner时间延迟，并检验电子发射方向依赖能否用于探测非对称分子势中的电子发射时间。
AI.method: 采用395 nm和790 nm共旋转双色激光场进行强场电离实验，反演得到依赖分子坐标系电子发射方向的Wigner时间延迟，并将其角依赖与基于分子Ammosov-Delone-Krainov（MO-ADK）理论的简单模型预测进行比较。摘要未提供具体实验装置、误差范围或数据处理细节。
AI.result: 测得的Wigner时间延迟随分子坐标系中的电子发射方向变化，变化幅度可达±70 as；其角依赖与MO-ADK简单模型的预测一致。摘要未给出统计不确定度或更具体的数值拟合结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在强场区域可以实验获取非对称分子势中电子发射时间的方向依赖。摘要未提供对其他分子体系或更详细物理机制的结论。

title: Numerical Studies of Ground State Atomic Parity Violation Measurements in Cesium
summary: We report results of numerical simulations of an ongoing measurement designed to measure the electric dipole (E1) transition moment between hyperfine components of the ground state of atomic cesium. This E1 moment is non-zero solely due to nuclear weak interactions between the nucleons, leading to a nuclear anapole moment of the cesium nucleus. Through these simulations, we explore the effect on the microwave spectrum of a static transverse magnetic field, a spatial offset of the atomic beam from the axis of the radio-frequency (rf) cavity, the angular tilt of the rf cavity, and the ac Stark shift by the Raman-coupling beams used to generate the initial superposition state between ground state components. The results of these simulations help place limits on the experimental parameters, and help guide the future experimental procedures.

title: Symmetry-Aware Residual Learning of Few-Body Molecular Wave Functions
comment: 32 pages, 15 figures. Meital Bojan and Mikhail Maslov contributed equally to this work
summary: Ultracold polar molecules are a highly controllable platform for engineering quantum matter, but modeling their few-body properties remains computationally challenging. Their anisotropic long-range interactions and rich internal structure lead to high-dimensional eigenvalue problems for which conventional grid-based solvers are largely restricted to two-molecule systems. To address this limitation, we introduce a physics-informed neural variational method that exploits known physical structure of the molecular wave function. Our key idea is to factor the wave function into analytic and neural components. The analytic component encodes rotational symmetry and asymptotic decay, while the neural residual learns the remaining intermediate-range behavior. This decomposition reduces the effective dimensionality of the problem without relying on ad hoc approximations or problem-specific discretization grids. We benchmark our method against high-accuracy two-molecule solvers and recover both ground and excited bound states with mean relative errors below 0.01%. We further demonstrate the method's applicability to three-body systems by computing field-linked trimer ground-state energies in percent-level agreement with an independent grid-based calculation. This provides a systematic route to larger molecular systems and opens opportunities to study correlations and dynamics in interacting quantum matter.

title: Quantization concealment of angular momentum: dynamic origin of spins
summary: Since their introduction, spins of elementary particles remain a phenomenological addition to modern quantum theories. While relatively recent studies on Dirac and other linearized equations of motion have revealed the spatial current nature of the spin magnetic moment (instead of the commonly pictured self-rotation), the dynamical origin of this circulating current remains unresolved. Here, we expose a long-overlooked generic shortcoming of wave mechanics ("quantization concealment of angular momentum") that undesirably reduces the canonical angular momentum of bound eigen-modes and renders incomplete the minimal coupling to magnetic fields. Recovering the kinetic orbital angular momentum resolves $1s$-orbital's counterintuitive "zero" angular momentum and reproduces all planar modes' anomalous Zeeman splitting. Regarding spins as effective remedy to the concealment offers natural explanations to their main puzzles: 1) dynamical origin of spin magnetic moment and 2) frame invariance of spin angular momentum. This implies absence of spin magnetic moment for free particles, a strong prediction verifiable through Stern-Gerlach experiments on electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文指出波动力学存在“角动量量子化隐藏”这一被长期忽视的普遍缺陷，它使束缚本征模的规范角动量被不合理削减，并导致磁场最小耦合不完整；通过恢复动能轨道角动量，并视自旋为对该缺陷的有效补救，文章解释了自旋磁矩的动力学起源与自旋角动量的参考系不变性，并预言自由粒子不存在自旋磁矩。

AI.method: 文章通过理论分析波力学，揭示“角动量量子化隐藏”这一普遍缺陷；恢复束缚本征模的动能轨道角动量，并将自旋视为对该隐藏缺陷的有效补救，从而重新分析轨道角动量、磁场最小耦合及塞曼分裂。
AI.result: 恢复动能轨道角动量后，1s 轨道反直觉的“零”角动量得到解释，并能重现所有平面模式的异常塞曼分裂；将自旋视为对量子化隐藏的有效补救，可自然解释两个主要疑难：自旋磁矩的动力学起源，以及自旋角动量的参考系不变性。
AI.conclusion: 文章认为自旋是对波动力学中角动量量子化隐藏的有效补救，并由此推断自由粒子不存在自旋磁矩；该强预言可通过电子斯特恩—格拉赫实验检验。摘要未提供具体实验数据或定量验证结果。

title: Squeezing-preserving coherent control in Fourier-shaped optical lattices
summary: Motional squeezed states of atoms in optical lattices are affected by the anharmonicity of the trapping potential. Unequal vibrational energy spacings cause dephasing among the occupied motional-state coherences, leading to distortion of the wavepacket and a reduction in squeezing. We show numerically that adding a weak second or third spatial harmonic to a one-dimensional lattice slows the initial decay of the squeezing. Squeezed states are prepared by one or two sudden changes of the lattice depth. For each harmonic and each preparation scheme, we choose the harmonic amplitude that keeps the evolved state closest, on average over 1 ms, to its evolution in a harmonic trap. We then compare the squeezing with that in a sinusoidal lattice with the same initial squeezing and trap frequency. In all four cases studied, the successive squeezing maxima initially decay more slowly in the shaped lattice. The improvement arises because the optimal harmonic nearly equalizes the two dominant vibrational level spacings over the region occupied by the squeezed wave packet, which canceling the quartic term of the potential alone does not achieve. Because the amplitude of the added harmonic is static and can be produced with existing Fourier-synthesis techniques, lattice shaping offers a simple way to preserve motional squeezing without additional time-dependent control.

AI.tldr: 该文用数值方法研究一维光晶格中原子运动压缩态在非谐势下的退相干问题，并提出通过加入弱的二次或三次空间谐波来减缓压缩的初始衰减。
AI.motivation: 光晶格势的非谐性导致振动能级间距不等，使占据的运动态相干发生退相位，造成波包畸变并降低压缩；作者希望找到一种无需额外时变控制的简单方法来保持运动压缩。
AI.method: 作者对一维光晶格加入弱的二次或三次空间谐波，并用数值模拟比较不同谐波与两种压缩态制备方案（一次或两次突然改变晶格深度）。对每种谐波和制备方案，选择使演化态在1 ms平均意义上最接近谐振阱演化的谐波幅度，再与具有相同初始压缩和阱频率的正弦晶格比较。
AI.result: 在研究的四种情形中，成形晶格中的 successive squeezing maxima 最初都衰减得更慢；改进的原因是优化谐波在所占据的压缩波包区域内几乎均衡两个主导振动能级间距，而仅抵消势的四次项不能实现这一点。摘要未给出具体数值参数或实验验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 由于附加谐波的幅度是静态的，并可用现有傅里叶合成技术产生，晶格整形提供了一种无需额外时变控制即可保持运动压缩的简单途径。

title: Designing quantum dynamics in squeezed potentials
summary: Geometry offers a versatile platform to control quantum transport. We investigate the ground-state properties and out-of-equilibrium dynamics of interacting bosons in a two-dimensional channel with two localized squeezes. The squeezes generate effective barriers along the longitudinal direction. These geometry-induced barriers modify the ground-state density distribution and lead to the emergence of many-body fragmentation. The squeezed channel also provides control over the transport dynamics, including the degree of self-trapping and the oscillation period. At the many-body level, the transport develops dynamical fragmentation, leading to the collapse of the density oscillations. We further demonstrate that introducing the two squeezes from opposite transverse directions generates oscillatory angular momentum during transport. The modified geometry also exhibits distinct many-body collapse behaviors associated with different patterns of fragmentation. Together, these results establish engineered squeezed confinement as a powerful tool for designing the ground-state properties and controlling the quantum transport, including angular-momentum generation and rich many-body transport dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有两个局域挤压的二维通道中相互作用玻色子的基态与量子输运，发现几何诱导势垒会改变密度分布并引发多体碎片化，同时可调控自俘获、振荡周期、动力学碎片化、密度振荡坍缩及振荡角动量。
AI.motivation: 几何为控制量子输运提供了灵活平台；作者希望揭示局域挤压形成的几何势垒如何影响相互作用玻色子的基态性质和非平衡动力学，并探索利用工程化挤压约束设计基态与操控输运。
AI.method: 研究对象为二维通道中的相互作用玻色子，通道内设置两个局域挤压；这些挤压沿纵向产生有效势垒。论文分析其基态密度分布、多体碎片化以及出平衡输运动力学，并比较两个挤压从相反横向方向引入时的情形。摘要未提供具体的理论模型参数、数值方法或实验实现细节。
AI.result: 挤压产生的有效势垒会改变基态密度分布并导致多体碎片化；挤压通道还能调节自俘获程度和振荡周期。多体层面出现动力学碎片化，并导致密度振荡坍缩。两个挤压从相反横向方向引入时，输运过程中会产生振荡角动量；不同碎片化模式对应不同的多体坍缩行为。
AI.conclusion: 工程化挤压约束可作为设计基态性质和调控量子输运的有力工具，能够产生角动量并呈现丰富的多体输运动力学。

title: A Monolithic Fully Eulerian Lattice Boltzmann Framework for Fluid--Structure Interaction with Neo-Hookean Elastic Solids
summary: We present a fully Eulerian, monolithic lattice Boltzmann method for fluid--structure interaction with incompressible neo-Hookean solids at unequal densities, and use it to compute the Turek--Hron FSI2 and FSI3 benchmarks on a single Cartesian grid. A pressure-based kinetic scheme advances the mixture momentum, a polynomial MTHINC reconstruction transports the solid volume fraction with closed-form fluxes, and the left Cauchy--Green tensor gives the elastic stress; all updates are explicit and local. Because the density is transported independently of the populations, two corrections are introduced. A lattice-link correction makes uniform translation an exact discrete solution for any density ratio, which is verified to round-off up to $ρ_s/ρ_f=1000$. A pressure-mode correction, derived from an asymptotic analysis of the scheme, removes the frame-dependent defect that otherwise causes a secular drift of the solid mass. The verification separates the two sources of error: the scheme is second-order accurate towards the diffuse-interface solution at fixed interface thickness, and first-order towards the sharp-interface solution when the thickness scales with the grid, as predicted by an estimate of the interfacial truncation error. The method reproduces a deformable disk in Taylor--Green and lid-driven-cavity flows, and the FSI3 and FSI2 benchmarks at density ratios of one and ten.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全欧拉、单体格子Boltzmann方法，用于不等密度不可压缩neo-Hookean固体的流固耦合，并在单一笛卡尔网格上复现Turek--Hron FSI2与FSI3基准。
AI.motivation: 针对不等密度下不可压缩neo-Hookean固体的流固耦合，需要全欧拉、单体且可在单一笛卡尔网格上计算Turek--Hron FSI2和FSI3基准的方法；由于密度独立于分布函数输运，还需处理均匀平移不一致及固体质量长期漂移等误差来源。摘要未提供更具体的应用背景。
AI.method: 采用压力基动力学格式推进混合物动量，用多项式MTHINC重构以闭式通量输运固体体积分数，并由左Cauchy--Green张量给出弹性应力；所有更新均为显式且局部。引入格子链接修正，使任意密度比下的均匀平移成为精确离散解，并在ρ_s/ρ_f=1000以内验证至舍入误差；引入由渐近分析导出的压力模态修正，以消除导致固体质量长期漂移的框架相关缺陷。
AI.result: 验证区分了两类误差来源：固定界面厚度时，格式对弥散界面解二阶收敛；界面厚度随网格缩放时，对尖锐界面解一阶收敛，与界面截断误差估计一致。方法复现了Taylor--Green流和顶盖驱动方腔流中的可变形圆盘，并在密度比为1和10时复现FSI3与FSI2基准。
AI.conclusion: 该全欧拉单体格子Boltzmann方法通过格子链接修正和压力模态修正，实现了任意密度比下均匀平移的精确离散解并消除固体质量长期漂移；数值验证给出所述二阶/一阶收敛行为，并成功复现指定流动与FSI基准。摘要未给出更广泛适用性的结论。

title: StePPO: Adaptive Step-Size Control for Initial-Value Problems Using Proximal Policy Optimisation
comment: Preprint for ICASSP & IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing submission
summary: ODE solvers are used to model, simulate, and analyse continuous-time systems found in many signal processing applications. Time integration of these initial-value problems is traditionally performed using adaptive embedded Runge--Kutta methods. For proper time-step selection, adaptive solvers accept or reject each candidate step according to a local error estimate. Their efficiency is therefore controlled by the rule that selects the next step size. Classical proportional--integral--derivative (PID) controllers are computationally inexpensive per decision and reliable, but their reactive design can lead to costly numerical solves near stiff transitions. We formulate step-size selection for parametrised IVPs as a Markov decision process and train a continuous-action policy using proximal policy optimisation. The policy processes its observation signals using a deep network while maintaining the embedded solver logic. We evaluate on a decay function, the Van der Pol system, and the Brusselator system at matched tolerances, and compare against a standard PID controller and a multi-scale DeepONet network. We find that the proposed learned policy remains within prescribed error tolerances while reducing the required number of solve steps by up to 60%, achieving a wall-clock time reduction of 58%, for both in- and out-of-distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 本文将参数化初值问题的步长选择建模为马尔可夫决策过程，使用PPO训练连续动作策略，并在保持嵌入式Runge--Kutta求解器逻辑的情况下，用深度网络处理观测信号。在衰减函数、Van der Pol系统和Brusselator系统上与PID控制器及多尺度DeepONet比较，所提策略在满足误差容限的同时最多减少60%求解步数，墙钟时间降低58%，且覆盖分布内与分布外设置。
AI.motivation: ODE求解器广泛用于信号处理中连续时间系统的建模、仿真与分析，传统上采用自适应嵌入式Runge--Kutta方法，并通过局部误差估计接受或拒绝候选步。求解效率主要由下一步步长选择规则决定；经典PID控制器计算便宜且可靠，但其反应式设计在刚性过渡附近可能导致代价较高的数值求解，因此需要更高效的步长选择策略。
AI.method: 论文将参数化初值问题的步长选择形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，采用近端策略优化（PPO）训练连续动作策略；该策略使用深度网络处理观测信号，同时保留嵌入式求解器逻辑。评估对象包括衰减函数、Van der Pol系统和Brusselator系统，并在匹配容差下与标准PID控制器和多尺度DeepONet网络进行比较。
AI.result: 在所评估系统上，学习到的步长策略保持在本文规定的误差容限内，并将所需求解步数最多减少60%，墙钟时间降低58%；这些结果在分布内和分布外设置中均成立。摘要未提供各基准系统的逐项数值、误差统计细节或与DeepONet的具体分项对比数据。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：学习式步长选择策略能够在保持数值精度的同时显著提升自适应ODE求解的计算效率，并在分布内与分布外场景中表现有效；摘要支持其相较标准PID控制器和多尺度DeepONet的比较评估，但未给出更细化的结论性指标。

title: Numerical model for ice formation in soil samples
summary:
Ice formation, or in general liquid crystallization, in porous media is important in various engineering contexts ranging
  from frost heave in soils to structural damage due to salt crystallization. Developing mesoscopic models for this problem is challenging due to the multitude of phenomena involved - fluid flow, phase transitions and complex porous geometries. In this work, we present an efficient numerical implementation addressing this class of problems. We use a phase field model with a non-conserved order parameter for liquid crystallization and solve it in a Lattice-Boltzmann framework. Our modifications to the phase field model enable the direct capture of important thermodynamic phenomena such as the Gibbs-Thomson effect and Soil Freezing Characteristic Curve (SFCC). We demonstrate our model's capabilities in sphere packings as well as in realistic soil geometries. Our model is able to resolve the pore-scale freezing and capture the macroscopic freezing behavior such as the hysteresis observed during freezing and thawing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于相场模型与格子玻尔兹曼框架的高效数值实现，用于模拟多孔介质中的液体结晶与结冰，并在球体堆积和真实土壤几何中验证了孔隙尺度冻结及宏观冻融滞回行为。
AI.motivation: 多孔介质中的结冰或液体结晶在土壤冻胀、盐结晶导致的结构损伤等工程场景中很重要；但由于涉及流体流动、相变和复杂孔隙几何等多种现象，构建介观模型具有挑战性。
AI.method: 采用非守恒序参量的相场模型描述液体结晶，并在格子玻尔兹曼框架中求解；通过对相场模型的修改，直接捕捉Gibbs-Thomson效应和土壤冻结特征曲线（SFCC）；在球体堆积和真实土壤几何中进行演示。
AI.result: 模型能够解析孔隙尺度冻结，并捕捉宏观冻结行为，包括冻结与融化过程中的滞回现象。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种面向多孔介质中液体结晶问题的高效数值实现，并展示了其在球体堆积和真实土壤几何中捕捉关键热力学现象及宏观冻融行为的能力。

title: AI Buckingham: Agentic Discovery of Dimensionless Scaling Laws Across Physical Regimes
comment: 7 main figures; Supplementary Information included (7 figures and 30 tables)
summary: Classical dimensional analysis defines admissible dimensionless representations but does not determine which combinations capture the dominant physical dependence, whether it changes across physical regimes, or when dependent-variable rescaling is required. We present AI Buckingham, an agentic framework for autonomous dimensionless discovery from natural-language descriptions of physical problems and observational data. It couples reasoning and planning by a large language model (LLM) with predefined symbolic and numerical tools. Literature-based knowledge retrieval supports dimensional checking, gradient-based clustering identifies physical regimes, and mutual information provides an objective, reparameterization-invariant criterion for identifying dominant dimensionless groups. Explicit numerical criteria determine the group count and assess simplification. Across ten physical systems spanning fluid dynamics, magnetohydrodynamics, thermal convection and additive manufacturing, AI Buckingham recovers established similarity representations and resolves regime-dependent scalings. For the longstanding challenge of predicting turbulent drag on rough surfaces, it identifies informative reparameterizations of surface statistics that improve equivalent sand-grain roughness estimates for engineering-oriented drag modelling.

AI.tldr: AI Buckingham 是一个将大语言模型推理规划与符号、数值工具耦合的自主量纲发现框架，可从自然语言物理问题描述和观测数据中识别无量纲表示。它在十个物理系统中恢复了已知相似性关系并解析了分 regime 标度；在粗糙表面湍流阻力问题上找到改善等效砂粒粗糙度估计的表面统计重参数化。
AI.motivation: 经典量纲分析只能给出可容许的无量纲表示，无法确定哪些组合主导物理依赖、这种依赖是否随物理 regime 变化，以及何时需要对因变量进行重标度。
AI.method: 该框架以自然语言问题描述和观测数据为输入，由大语言模型负责推理与规划，并调用预定义符号和数值工具；使用文献知识检索支持量纲检查，用梯度聚类识别物理 regime，以互信息作为客观且对重参数化不变的主导无量纲群识别准则，并通过显式数值准则确定群数量及评估简化。
AI.result: 在涵盖流体动力学、磁流体动力学、热对流和增材制造的十个物理系统中，AI Buckingham 恢复了已有相似性表示并解析了随 regime 变化的标度关系；针对粗糙表面湍流阻力的长期难题，它识别出可提高等效砂粒粗糙度估计的表面统计信息重参数化，服务于工程导向的阻力建模。
AI.conclusion: AI Buckingham 展示了将 LLM 推理规划与工具化符号数值分析结合、自动发现无量纲群和 regime 相关标度的能力，并能在粗糙表面阻力建模中产生有工程价值的信息性重参数化；但摘要未提供定量精度、误差界、超出十个系统的泛化性及局限性细节。

title: Estimating subcritical multiplication from stochastic neutron noise: a branching Brownian motion model for leakage counts
summary: A neutron detector placed outside a subcritical system records fission chains as correlated bursts of counts. The time dependence of these correlations gives access to the $α$ eigenvalues governing the decay of the system and, with additional physical information, to its effective multiplication factor $k_{\mathrm{eff}}$. The usual analysis relies on point kinetics, which ignores where chains are born and which neutrons escape. We examine this approximation in a model simple enough to be solved: branching Brownian motion, that is, one-group neutron diffusion with capture and fission, in a domain whose absorbing boundary plays the role of the detector. For a stationary Poisson source we derive the Feynman $Y$ function (the count variance-to-mean ratio minus one) by following pairs of neutrons from their common ancestor to their detection. In a homogeneous cube the result is an explicit sum over spatial modes whose weights are fixed by the geometry and the source. We compare it with direct branching simulations and with one-speed OpenMC transport calculations in which fission is sampled with analog reaction selection and FREYA multiplicities. At the longest simulated gate the model agrees with transport to about $1\%$ at $k=0.8$ and $0.9$, and to $10\%$ at $k=0.5$. The corresponding point-model discrepancies range from $25$ to $48\%$. When geometry, source and material parameters are known, retaining the spatial modes also reduces the bias on the inferred multiplication factor. Two extensions prepare the use of the model in inverse problems. Correlations between opposite faces distinguish systems that share the same fundamental decay rate but differ in leakage, and a hierarchy of three stationary problems links this spatial benchmark to multiplicity counting. Modal convergence, detector imbalance and spectral evolution remain limitations for quantitative inference.

AI.tldr: 该文用可解的分支布朗运动模型检验点动力学在空间相关裂变链分析中的近似误差：推导均匀立方体中的Feynman Y函数，并与直接分支模拟及OpenMC输运计算比较，显示保留空间模态可显著改善符合度并降低推断k_eff的偏差。
AI.motivation: 传统基于点动力学的分析忽略裂变链的诞生位置和泄漏中子，可能影响相关计数及有效增殖因子推断；作者希望在足够简单且可解析的模型中定量考察这一近似的有效性。
AI.method: 将系统建模为含俘获和裂变的一群中子扩散，即分支布朗运动，以吸收边界模拟探测器；对稳态泊松源，通过追踪来自共同祖先的中子对至被探测，推导Feynman Y函数（计数方差与均值之比减一）。在均匀立方体中给出按空间模态展开的显式结果，并与直接分支模拟以及采用模拟反应选择和FREYA多重数的一速OpenMC输运计算比较。
AI.result: 在最长的模拟门宽下，该模型与输运计算在k=0.8和0.9时符合到约1%，在k=0.5时符合到10%；相应点模型偏差为25%至48%。当几何、源和材料参数已知时，保留空间模态还能降低推断增殖因子的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 空间模态对裂变链相关计数和k_eff推断有可观影响，点动力学近似会引入显著偏差。作者还提出利用相对面的相关性区分具有相同基模衰减率但泄漏不同的系统，并用三个稳态问题构成的层级把该空间基准与多重数计数联系起来；模态收敛、探测器不平衡和能谱演化仍是定量推断的限制。

title: A nonequilibrium-capturing unified gas-kinetic scheme II: multi-frequency radiation transport
summary: Conventional discrete ordinate methods are widely used for thermal radiative transfer, but their fixed number of angular degrees of freedom (DoFs) incurs unnecessary computational cost near equilibrium. We therefore develop a nonequilibrium-capturing unified gas-kinetic scheme (NCUGKS) for multi-frequency radiation transport. The scheme preserves the mul tiscale capability of UGKS through interface evolution that couples transport and collision. Radiation intensity is expanded in an orthonormal basis of the discrete angular space. The expansion coefficients serve as angular DoFs, with their number adapted independently to local nonequilibrium in each cell, frequency group, and quadrant. At each time step, the coefficients to be evolved are selected using the exponentially decayed contribution from the previous step and the requirements of interface transport. The selected coefficients are advanced by the finite volume scheme and corrected to match the macroscopic radiation energy before higher-degree coefficients are discarded according to the prescribed relative tail tolerance. Therefore, in the optically thick limit, the resulting representation retains only one angular DoF per quadrant. Numerical tests spanning different optical regimes show close agreement with reference solutions, validating its accuracy. Furthermore, in terms of memory and computational efficiency, the proposed method reduces memory by factors from 21.7 to 154.0 and achieves speedups from 24.87 to 257.9 compared with the original discrete ordinate UGKS. NCUGKS thus provides the ability to accurately simulate multiscale ra diative transfer with reduced memory and computational costs. The proposed approach also offers a framework for adapting angular degrees of freedom in other discrete ordinate methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于多频辐射输运的非平衡捕捉统一气体动理学格式（NCUGKS），通过按单元、频率组和象限自适应调整角度自由度，在保持多尺度能力的同时显著降低离散坐标方法的计算与存储成本。
AI.motivation: 传统离散坐标方法广泛用于热辐射输运，但其固定的角度自由度数量在接近平衡态时会造成不必要的计算开销；因此需要一种能准确模拟多尺度辐射输运且降低内存和计算成本的方法。
AI.method: 作者发展了NCUGKS。该格式通过耦合输运与碰撞的界面演化保持UGKS的多尺度能力；将辐射强度在离散角度空间的正交基上展开，展开系数作为角度自由度，并按每个单元、频率组和象限的局部非平衡程度独立自适应。每个时间步中，依据上一步的指数衰减贡献和界面输运需求选择待演化系数，用有限体积格式推进，并校正以匹配宏观辐射能量，随后按预设相对尾部容差丢弃高阶系数。因此在光学厚极限下，每个象限仅保留一个角度自由度。
AI.result: 跨不同光学区域的数值测试与参考解吻合良好，验证了精度；与原始离散坐标UGKS相比，所提方法将内存降低21.7至154.0倍，并获得24.87至257.9倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: NCUGKS能够以更低的内存和计算成本准确模拟多尺度辐射输运，并为其他离散坐标方法中角度自由度的自适应提供框架。

title: Fewer Parameters, Longer Runtimes: The Wall-Clock Cost of Hybrid Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: While hybrid quantum-classical physics-informed neural networks (QCPINNs) are often described as efficient because they have fewer trainable parameters than classical PINNs, parameter count does not measure wall-clock cost. To examine this gap on a one-dimensional seawater temperature diffusion benchmark, with the quantum circuits simulated on a CPU, we time the four cumulative stages a PINN needs (the forward pass, the first- and second-order input gradients, and the PDE-loss parameter gradient) for a classical PINN, four hybrid configurations that differ in qubit count and circuit depth, and size-matched classical controls that share the hybrids' classical layers. We find that the hybrids are 14-56x slower than the classical PINN for the forward pass and 10-97x slower for the PDE-loss parameter gradient, and even against the size-matched controls, they remain 9-85x slower. Further, over the tested ranges, runtime increased approximately exponentially with qubit count, approximately linearly with circuit depth, and sub-linearly with batch size, while for the circuit-only forward pass, a second simulator backend was 10-165x slower under the same calling pattern. Although the hybrids have 38-44% fewer parameters than the classical PINN, this reduction comes from their smaller classical layers, as the quantum circuit accounts for at most 2.5% of each hybrid's parameters. Yet parameter count failed to predict runtime even among the classical networks, since the size-matched controls, despite having fewer parameters than the classical PINN, run slower than it. Our conclusion is that fewer parameters did not mean lower cost: every hybrid took at least ten times longer than the classical PINN at every stage, and the gap grew quickly with the number of qubits.

AI.tldr: 该文以一维海水温度扩散基准为例，在CPU模拟量子电路条件下比较混合量子-经典物理信息神经网络（QCPINNs）与经典PINN的实际运行时间，发现参数更少并不等于计算成本更低：混合模型在各阶段均至少慢10倍，且差距随量子比特数快速增大。
AI.motivation: 作者指出，混合量子-经典PINN常因可训练参数少于经典PINN而被描述为高效，但参数数量并不能衡量实际运行时间（wall-clock cost）。因此，本文旨在考察这一效率判断与实际计时成本之间的差距。
AI.method: 在一维海水温度扩散基准上，量子电路由CPU模拟。作者对经典PINN、四种不同量子比特数与电路深度的混合配置，以及与混合模型共享经典层、参数量匹配的经典对照网络，分别计时PINN所需的四个累积阶段：前向传播、一阶输入梯度、二阶输入梯度以及PDE损失的参数梯度。作者还测试了运行时间随量子比特数、电路深度和批大小的变化，并对仅含电路的首次前向传播比较了第二个模拟器后端。
AI.result: 混合模型前向传播比经典PINN慢14–56倍，PDE损失参数梯度慢10–97倍；即使与参数量匹配的经典对照相比，仍慢9–85倍。在所测范围内，运行时间随量子比特数近似指数增长、随电路深度近似线性增长、随批大小亚线性增长；仅电路前向传播在相同调用模式下，第二个模拟器后端慢10–165倍。混合模型参数比经典PINN少38–44%，但这一减少来自更小的经典层，量子电路最多仅占每个混合模型参数的2.5%。参数量也无法预测经典网络间的运行时间：参数量匹配的对照网络虽然参数更少，却比经典PINN更慢。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论是：更少参数并不意味着更低成本；每个混合模型在每一阶段都至少比经典PINN慢十倍，而且差距随量子比特数增加而迅速扩大。

title: SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN: A Double-Group SU(2) Hyper-/Meta-Graph Neural Network for Cooperative Spin-Crossover Potential Energy Surfaces
summary: Learning potential energy surfaces for magnetic materials requires resolving coupled local spin manifolds and geometric frustration. We introduce SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN, a geometry-only architecture combining a pretrained O(3)-equivariant backbone with SU(2) spinor Hamiltonians and cooperative hyper-/meta-graph interactions. Analytic thermal spinor density matrices provide non-polynomial two- and three-body structural invariants, while frustrated-triangle hyperedges and a multi-shell sideway gate couple geometric representations to local spin manifolds. A variationally consistent, doubly-centered zero-gauge free-energy functional couples multiplet occupations and signed spin orientations, yielding conservative autograd forces without spin inputs at inference. On a first-principles Co-Cr-Ni benchmark comprising 346 training and 59 held-out validation supercells across crystalline, amorphous, glassy, and liquid regimes, compact models with 56k-77k parameters outperform a 207k-parameter spin-conditioned magnetic MACE baseline. Energy MAE decreases by 37-44%, reaching 3.82 versus 6.83 meV/atom, and force MAE decreases by 10.8-14.2 meV/Angstrom, reaching 165.8-169.2 versus 180.0 meV/Angstrom. The models preserve Kramers degeneracy to within $6\times10^{-15}$ eV, predict equilibrium local magnetic moments from geometry alone with an absolute-moment MAE of $0.181\,μ_B$, and support stable molecular dynamics up to 2,200 K. This framework integrates local spinor symmetry and cooperative magnetic interactions into geometry-only interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 提出仅几何输入的SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN磁势能面模型，在Co-Cr-Ni基准上以56k–77k参数超越207k参数的自旋条件化MACE基线，并保持Kramers简并、由几何预测磁矩及支持高温分子动力学。
AI.motivation: 学习磁性材料势能面需同时解析耦合的局域自旋流形与几何阻挫；该工作旨在将局域旋量对称性和协同磁相互作用纳入仅依赖几何输入的原子间势，并避免推理时输入自旋。

title: Backpropagation as Dirac-bracket dynamics of dissipative training
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to Physical Review E
summary: Gradient-based training of a parametric model is the motion of a damped particle in the potential set by the loss. Using the Bateman-Galley doubling of the degrees of freedom, which gives dissipative systems an action principle, we write gradient flow, the heavy-ball method and Nesterov's accelerated gradient method as Hamiltonian systems. We show that, within this Hamiltonian description, backpropagation is Dirac evolution. The activations of a feed-forward network are treated as coordinates of phase space, and the layer equations as constraints. These constraints are second class for every architecture, and Hamilton's equations with the resulting Dirac bracket reproduce training with the exact gradient of the loss, although the Hamiltonian contains only the cost of the network output. The Dirac bracket of an activation with the momenta of the parameters is its Jacobian, the inverse of the constraint matrix contains both the forward and the reverse modes of automatic differentiation, and the errors propagated by backpropagation are the Lagrange multipliers of the layer constraints: the constraint forces of a kinematic chain under the load of the cost. These results hold in the full doubled phase space, not only in the physical limit. The network's part of the constraint algebra is the same for every optimizer, Nesterov's look-ahead adds one layer of momentum-dependent constraints that couple the two copies of the doubled system, and gradient flow is obtained by constructing the Dirac bracket in stages. We confirm these statements numerically to machine precision and train a network by integrating the Dirac flow of its constraints, with no backward pass in the computation.

AI.tldr: 论文用 Bateman-Galley 自由度加倍把梯度流、heavy-ball 和 Nesterov 加速梯度写成哈密顿系统，并将前馈网络的反向传播解释为 Dirac 演化：层方程作为第二类约束，反传误差是层约束的拉格朗日乘子；数值上达到机器精度，并可在无反向传播的情况下通过积分 Dirac 流训练网络。

title: Structure-preserving finite element method for the 2D MHD-$α$ turbulence system
summary: We propose a structure-preserving finite element method for the two-dimensional MHD-$α$ turbulence model, which filters the transport velocity at a length $α$ while retaining the ideal invariants of the original MHD equations, with the energy replaced by an $α$-dependent energy. The scheme preserves mass conservation and the magnetic Gauss law pointwise and satisfies discrete dissipation laws for the energy, the cross helicity and the mean square magnetic potential, which reduce to exact conservation in the ideal limit. The discrete systems are solved by an augmented Lagrangian preconditioner with monolithic geometric multigrid, observed to be robust with respect to the filter width $α$ and the Reynolds numbers, and to the mesh size for small time steps. The scheme converges at the optimal rates and agrees with a Fourier pseudo-spectral direct simulation of the original MHD equations at the large scales. In under-resolved flows, the unfiltered scheme has no numerical dissipation and accumulates energy at the grid scale. Filtering relieves this accumulation and a larger $α$ gives a more compact spectrum. Long-time simulations reproduce selective decay, including relaxation toward the Arnold-type bound and the inverse cascade of the mean square potential.

AI.tldr: 提出二维MHD-α湍流模型的结构保持有限元方法，逐点保持质量守恒和磁高斯定律，满足能量、交叉螺旋度及均方磁势的离散耗散律，并用稳健的增广泛函拉格朗日预条件子与单体几何多重网格求解；格式达到最优收敛阶，复现大尺度直接模拟结果及长期选择性衰减行为。

title: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
summary: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. Furthermore, several recent approaches to characterizing heterogeneous and graded materials employ parameter-heavy, deep learning-based frameworks trained to enforce force equilibrium at specified collocation points within the material. In this work, we propose an interpretable and time-efficient framework that predicts the three-dimensional relative spatial variation of a constitutive parameter field for multiple parameters of a heterogeneous hyperelastic material, using only displacement-field data. In this work, we validate our framework on 3D synthetic and 2D experimental benchmarks involving heterogeneous, graded, and anisotropic hyperelastic materials. By leveraging the linear nature of the inverse problem for hyperelastic materials and directly optimizing for the constitutive parameters at the finite-element level, we achieve acceptable prediction accuracy with significantly lower computational time compared to recently reported deep-learning-based frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可解释且高效的反演框架，仅利用位移场数据预测非均质超弹性材料多个本构参数的三维相对空间变化，并在合成与实验基准上验证了精度与计算效率。

AI.method: 提出可解释、时间高效的框架，仅使用位移场数据预测非均质超弹性材料多个本构参数场的三维相对空间变化；利用超弹性材料反问题的线性特性，在有限元层面直接优化本构参数。
AI.result: 在涉及非均质、梯度和各向异性超弹性材料的3D合成基准与2D实验基准上进行了验证；获得可接受的预测精度，且计算时间显著低于近期报道的深度学习框架。摘要未提供具体误差指标或计算时间数值。

title: Quantum Metric Connects Bond Delocalization to Phonon Softening
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures in main text. 14 pages, 1 figure in supplemental material
summary: Delocalized bonding electrons have long been associated with soft bonds and low phonon frequencies. However, a quantitative connection between electron delocalization and phonon softening remains elusive. We identify such a connection through the momentum-space quantum metric, which measures the intrinsic delocalization of the occupied electronic states. We show that a quantum geometric contribution to phonon softening is proportional to the integrated quantum metric. First-principles calculations of more than a hundred compounds demonstrate that greater quantum metric generally accompanies softer phonons. Localized Wannier orbitals reveal the bonding environments associated with this delocalization. In ferroelectric GeTe, LiBeSb, and BaTiO$_3$, polar distortion localizes the bonding orbitals, reduces quantum metric, and stabilizes the soft mode of the nonpolar structure. In PbSe, pressure-induced band inversion is accompanied by an enhanced quantum metric and phonon softening without change in crystal symmetry and bonding. These results establish a common quantum geometric interpretation of bond delocalization and phonon softening across distinct bonding environments.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了电子离域与声子软化之间的定量联系：以动量空间量子度量衡量占据电子态的本征离域程度，并证明声子软化的量子几何贡献正比于积分量子度量。对百余种化合物的第一性原理计算表明，量子度量越大通常伴随越软的声子；局域Wannier轨道揭示了相关成键环境，并在GeTe、LiBeSb、BaTiO3和PbSe中给出统一解释。
AI.motivation: 电子离域长期被认为与软键和低声子频率相关，但电子离域与声子软化之间的定量联系仍未明确。本文旨在识别并建立这种联系。
AI.method: 采用动量空间量子度量来度量占据电子态的本征离域程度，推导出声子软化的量子几何贡献与积分量子度量成正比；对超过一百种化合物进行第一性原理计算，并用局域Wannier轨道揭示与离域相关的成键环境。案例包括铁电GeTe、LiBeSb和BaTiO3中极性畸变使成键轨道局域化、降低量子度量并稳定非极性结构的软模，以及PbSe中压力诱导的能带反转伴随量子度量增强和声子软化，而晶体对称性和成键不变。
AI.result: 第一性原理计算显示，更大的量子度量通常伴随更软的声子。GeTe、LiBeSb和BaTiO3中，极性畸变通过局域化成键轨道降低量子度量并稳定非极性结构的软模；PbSe中，压力诱导能带反转增强量子度量并导致声子软化，同时晶体对称性和成键未发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果在不同成键环境中建立了电子离域与声子软化的共同量子几何解释。

title: Dopamine: A Cartesian grid large-eddy-simulation framework for coastal ocean modelling of free-surface waves
summary: We present a Cartesian staggered-grid large-eddy simulation framework for modelling coastal ocean waves using the Dopamine solver. The framework combines a geometric volume-of-fluid method for simulating free-surface wave evolution with one-way-coupled Lagrangian point-particle tracking for heavy and buoyant particles. A ghost-cell immersed-boundary method represents stationary solid boundaries, including the seabed and coastal obstacles, and their interaction with free-surface waves. The framework includes the Vreman and anisotropic minimum-dissipation (AMD) sub-grid-scale models for simulating near-wall turbulence. Comparisons with analytical solutions and established experimental and numerical benchmarks illustrate the framework's ability to reproduce wave dynamics and particle motion. The results provide promising insights into the framework's capabilities for coastal ocean modelling applications focused on investigating small-scale turbulent physics using a low-numerical-dissipation approach. The solver runs on multi-CPU architectures, with two-fluid strong- and weak-scaling efficiencies at 512 ranks relative to 64 ranks of up to 77% and 73%, respectively, and a single-GPGPU build has been verified against the CPU solver.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于Dopamine求解器的笛卡尔交错网格大涡模拟框架，结合几何VOF、单向耦合拉格朗日点粒子追踪、幽灵单元浸没边界及Vreman/AMD亚网格模型，用于模拟海岸海浪、固体边界相互作用及重/浮力粒子运动，并验证其精度与并行性能。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确给出研究动机；其应用导向是海岸海洋建模，重点在于以低数值耗散方法研究小尺度湍流物理。
AI.method: 采用Dopamine求解器构建笛卡尔交错网格大涡模拟框架；用几何体积分数法模拟自由表面波浪演化，用单向耦合拉格朗日点粒子追踪模拟重粒子和浮力粒子，用幽灵单元浸没边界法表示海床和海岸障碍物等静止固体边界及其与自由表面波的相互作用；引入Vreman和各向异性最小耗散（AMD）亚网格尺度模型模拟近壁湍流。
AI.result: 与解析解以及已有实验和数值基准的比较表明，该框架能够重现波浪动力学和粒子运动；在512个进程相对64个进程时，双流体强扩展和弱扩展效率分别最高达77%和73%；单GPGPU版本已与CPU求解器进行对比验证。
