title: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
comment: 11 pages, 14 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026). Code: https://github.com/soot-bit/pinnslicer
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below $10^{-3}$ in $u = r_s/r$ (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.

AI.tldr: PINN-Slicer 通过利用二阶自治常微分方程对自变量平移的不变性，将单个 PINN 在薄切片上训练后递归部署到整个长时程域，从而避免随域增长反复重训练；在黑洞光子轨道方程上取得低于 10^-3 的逐点 RMSE，并可泛化到训练范围内的初始条件及未知先验的解域。
AI.motivation: 传统 PINNs 在长时程域上通常表现困难，且随着求解域扩大往往需要重新训练网络；本文旨在解决这一长时程求解与重复训练问题。
AI.method: 针对形如 ddot{u}=G(u,dot{u}) 的二阶自治常微分方程，利用该类方程在自变量平移下的不变性提出 PINN-Slicer：将单个 PINN 嵌入显式满足初始条件的解拟设中，在自变量的一个薄切片上使用 Sobol 采样的初始条件进行训练，然后按切片递归部署到整个求解域。
AI.result: 在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上进行演示，相对于有限差分参考解，在 u=r_s/r（以 Schwarzschild 半径为单位的倒数径向坐标）上达到逐点 RMSE 低于 10^-3；单个已训练网络无需重新训练即可泛化到训练范围内的任意轨道初始条件，并且能够处理事先未知的解域。
AI.conclusion: PINN-Slicer 为长时程二阶自治常微分方程提供了一种基于切片递归部署的求解方式，减少了域增长带来的重训练需求，并展现出对训练范围内初始条件的泛化能力及对未知先验解域的适应能力。

title: Data-driven framework for invariant manifold identification in multiscale systems
summary: Multiscale dynamical systems often exhibit fast transient behavior followed by slow evolution on a low-dimensional attracting manifold, on which their long-term dynamics unfold. Identifying this structure directly from data remains challenging when the governing equations, Jacobians, and fast-slow variable partitions are unknown. In this work, we propose a fully data-driven framework for timescale decomposition, slow invariant manifold (SIM) approximation, and reduced-order model identification. A sparse-regression surrogate of the vector field is reconstructed from the data, and its Jacobian, estimated with a matrix-free Krylov method, is analysed with Computational Singular Perturbation diagnostics. The resulting fast-slow partition guides the learning of explicit SIM algebraic representations through regression, and the reduced model follows by restricting the dynamics to it. For a linear stochastic system, this regression agrees with the Mori-Zwanzig projection at leading order in the timescale ratio. We demonstrate the validity of the framework on an illustrative linear system, the Michaelis-Menten model, a biofilm growth model, and a five-dimensional target-mediated drug disposition (TMDD) model. The method accurately identifies fast variables, reconstructs slow invariant manifolds, and generates accurate reduced models. Furthermore, we map the performance boundaries of the framework under sparse sampling and measurement noise, showing robust recovery for low-dimensional systems and highlighting data-requirement limits in higher dimensions. These results demonstrate that interpretable multiscale reduction can be achieved directly from time-series data, without requiring explicit prior knowledge of the underlying fast/slow timescale separation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全数据驱动框架，用于时间尺度分解、慢不变流形（SIM）近似和降阶模型辨识：以稀疏回归代理向量场，用矩阵自由Krylov方法估计Jacobian，结合计算奇异摄动（CSP）诊断划分快慢变量，再通过回归学习显式SIM并限制动力学得到降阶模型；在多个示例系统上验证，并分析稀疏采样与测量噪声下的性能边界。
AI.motivation: 多尺度动力系统常先经历快瞬态，随后在低维吸引流形上慢演化，但 governing equations、Jacobian 和快慢变量划分未知时，直接从数据识别该结构仍很困难；作者希望无需显式先验的快慢时间尺度分离知识，直接从时间序列数据实现可解释的多尺度降阶。
AI.method: 从数据重建向量场的稀疏回归代理；采用矩阵自由Krylov方法估计其Jacobian，并用计算奇异摄动（CSP）诊断分析以获得快慢变量划分；基于该划分，通过回归学习显式SIM代数表示，再将动力学限制到SIM上得到降阶模型。在线性随机系统中，该回归在时间尺度比的领头阶与Mori-Zwanzig投影一致。方法在 illustrative linear system、Michaelis-Menten模型、生物膜生长模型和五维靶向介导药物处置（TMDD）模型上演示，并考察稀疏采样和测量噪声下的性能边界。
AI.result: 该方法能够准确识别快变量、重建慢不变流形并生成准确的降阶模型；在低维系统中，面对稀疏采样和测量噪声仍能稳健恢复，而在更高维度中暴露出数据需求限制。摘要未提供具体数值误差或定量性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无需显式先验的快慢时间尺度分离知识，也可以直接从时间序列数据实现可解释的多尺度降阶；同时，框架性能受系统维度和数据数量/质量约束。

title: OrbACE: Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion
summary:
Accurate electronic-structure reference data are expensive, motivating interatomic potentials that learn effectively from limited training sets. We introduce OrbACE (Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion), a framework that supplements an E(3)-equivariant cluster-expansion backbone with inexpensive electronic-structure descriptors. On ANI-1x at the $ω$B97X/6-31G* level, its atom-centered variant, OrbACE-A, trained on 10,000 configurations and evaluated on 442,000 held-out configurations, achieves energy and force mean absolute errors of 3.16 meV/atom and 76 meV/angstrom in direct learning, compared with 9.61 meV/atom and 146 meV/angstrom for MACE with matched backbone settings. This reduces the energy error by a factor of three and approximately halves the force error. Its energy error is also below that of the best delta-corrected MACE baseline, 5.00 meV/atom, although its force error is slightly higher. Combining OrbACE-A with a Hartree-Fock delta baseline further reduces the errors to 1.48 meV/atom and 35 meV/angstrom.
  OrbACE-A builds atom- and pair-resolved invariants from a non-self-consistent extended-Hueckel model evaluated within the differentiable forward pass, yielding forces consistent with the predicted energy. The orbital variant, OrbACE-O, instead uses localized Hartree-Fock orbitals as graph nodes, with scalar and equivariant electronic descriptors. Its forces are evaluated at fixed descriptors, omitting their response to nuclear motion. In direct learning on ANI-1x, its energy error is approximately three times that of OrbACE-A. The three benchmarks considered (ANI-1x, revised MD17, and 3BPA) cover neutral, closed-shell, non-periodic molecules containing H, C, N, and O. Performance outside this domain remains to be established.

AI.tldr: 提出 OrbACE 框架，将 E(3) 等变原子簇展开主干与低成本电子结构描述符结合；在 ANI-1x 上，OrbACE-A 的直接学习精度显著优于匹配主干设置的 MACE，结合 Hartree-Fock delta 基线后误差进一步降低。
AI.motivation: 精确电子结构参考数据获取成本高，因此需要能够从有限训练集中有效学习的原子间势。
AI.method: OrbACE 在 E(3) 等变原子簇展开主干上加入低成本电子结构描述符。OrbACE-A 为原子中心变体，在可微前向传播中基于非自洽扩展 Hückel 模型构建原子分辨与对分辨不变量，并使力与预测能量一致。OrbACE-O 使用局域 Hartree-Fock 轨道作为图节点，采用标量与等变电子描述符，但其力在固定描述符下计算，忽略描述符对核运动的响应。基准包括 ANI-1x、修订版 MD17 和 3BPA，覆盖含 H、C、N、O 的中性、闭壳层、非周期分子。
AI.result: 在 ωB97X/6-31G* 水平的 ANI-1x 上，OrbACE-A 用 10,000 个构型训练、在 442,000 个留出构型上评估，直接学习的能量与力平均绝对误差分别为 3.16 meV/atom 和 76 meV/angstrom；匹配主干设置的 MACE 为 9.61 meV/atom 和 146 meV/angstrom，即能量误差降低至约三分之一、力误差约减半。其能量误差也低于最佳 delta 校正 MACE 基线的 5.00 meV/atom，但力误差略高。OrbACE-A 与 Hartree-Fock delta 基线结合后，误差进一步降至 1.48 meV/atom 和 35 meV/angstrom。直接学习中，OrbACE-O 的能量误差约为 OrbACE-A 的三倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，引入低成本电子结构描述符可提升有限数据下的学习精度，OrbACE-A 在直接学习和与 Hartree-Fock delta 基线结合时均表现良好；但当前验证仅限于含 H、C、N、O 的中性、闭壳层、非周期分子，域外性能尚待确定。

title: Graphical Rules for Zero-energy Quantum-Interference Patterns in Bipartite Lattices
summary: Quantum interference(QI) plays an important role in electron transport in molecules, where conductance is determined by the coherent superposition of different quantum-walk paths connecting the source and drain sites. In some systems, the pronounced even-odd conductance oscillation with the walk length can be observed; meanwhile destructive QI can lead to a dramatic suppression of conductance, resulting in a huge on/off ratio. In this paper, we extend the investigation from individual molecules to bipartite lattice systems, providing an abstract framework for exploring QI in a broad range of two-dimensional systems. We propose a simple graphical rule for predicting the QI pattern-the conductance map obtained by varying the drain site while keeping the source site fixed-in bipartite structures with arbitrary boundaries and holes. The analysis can be completed in three steps. First, a unit-cell-replicated bipartite subset is constructed by removing a subset of atoms from the input network, and its Green's function map is efficiently obtained from a local recurrence relation. Second, the removed atoms and local structural modifications are coupled back as local degrees of freedom, generating zero-mode vectors through the same Green's function map. Finally, the surviving zero-mode combinations are selected by an effective coupling matrix, whose projectors correct the reference map to yield the final QI pattern. This rule applies to finite flakes with arbitrary boundaries and holes and extends naturally to infinite lattices and vacancy defects.

AI.tldr: 本文将量子干涉（QI）分析从单个分子推广到具有任意边界和空洞的二分晶格体系，提出一种三步图形化规则，用于预测固定源极、改变漏极时得到的电导图，并可自然推广到无限晶格和空位缺陷。摘要未给出数值验证或实验数据。
AI.motivation: 电子输运中的电导由连接源极与漏极的不同量子行走路径的相干叠加决定，甚至可出现奇偶电导振荡、破坏性QI导致的电导强烈抑制和巨大开关比。作者希望突破对单个分子的研究，建立适用于广泛二维二分晶格体系的抽象框架和可预测QI模式的简单图形规则。
AI.method: 方法分为三步：首先从输入网络中移除部分原子，构造单位晶胞复制的二分子集，并利用局部递推关系高效获得其格林函数图；其次将移除的原子和局部结构修改作为局域自由度耦合回体系，通过同一格林函数图生成零模向量；最后用有效耦合矩阵筛选存活的零模组合，并以其投影算符修正参考图，得到最终QI模式。
AI.result: 摘要提出了一种可预测二分结构中QI模式的简单图形规则，适用于具有任意边界和空洞的有限薄片，并可自然推广到无限晶格和空位缺陷。该方法的目标输出是固定源位点、改变漏位点所得的电导图；摘要未提供具体数值结果、精度评估或实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：QI研究可从单个分子扩展到二分晶格体系，并通过“子集格林函数图—零模生成—有效耦合投影修正”的三步框架，对复杂边界、空洞、无限晶格及空位缺陷中的电导干涉图样进行图形化预测。

title: Data-free continuous-time physics-informed neural networks for vortex shedding: a consistent pressure across time windows
summary: Without data, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in continuous time have so far failed to develop vortex shedding past a circular cylinder in a domain symmetric about the wake centerline: the training converges to the steady symmetric solution. We obtain shedding at Re=100 with a continuous-time PINN trained over successive time windows, without any reference data and without temporal discretization, the symmetry being broken by an analytical, divergence-free initial condition. The Strouhal number and the mean drag coefficient agree with an OpenFOAM solution computed on the same domain to within 0.5%. The pressure, however, is discontinuous at the junctions between windows, and the lift coefficient is a staircase. We relate this discontinuity to the differential-algebraic structure of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, of index 2 after spatial discretization: a consistent initial condition of each window must satisfy the constraint $\nabla\cdot\mathbf{v}=0$ for the velocity, and the hidden constraint $\nabla\cdot\partial_t\mathbf{v}=0$, with $\partial_t\mathbf{v}$ given by the momentum equation, then determines the pressure. Imposing the pressure alone makes the solution continuous but not consistent; our remedy imposes the pressure at the junctions and adds this hidden constraint to the loss. Over five shedding periods, the jumps of the lift coefficient become 20 times smaller.

AI.tldr: 连续时间PINN在无参考数据时难以从对称初值发展出圆柱涡脱落；作者用逐时间窗训练和解析无散度初始条件在Re=100获得涡脱落，结果与OpenFOAM吻合到0.5%以内，但窗口交界处压力不连续、升力呈阶梯状；将问题归因于不可压Navier-Stokes空间离散后的指数2微分代数结构，并在损失中加入隐藏约束后，五个脱落周期内升力跳变缩小20倍。
AI.motivation: 无数据的连续时间PINN在关于尾流中心线对称的区域中训练会收敛到稳态对称解，无法形成圆柱绕流涡脱落；论文旨在不依赖参考数据、不做时间离散的情况下获得涡脱落，并解释和改善分时间窗训练在窗口交界处产生的不一致。
AI.method: 采用连续时间PINN在连续的时间窗上依次训练；用解析的、无散度的初始条件打破对称性；将窗口交界处压力不连续与不可压Navier-Stokes方程经空间离散后的指数2微分代数结构联系起来：每个窗口的一致初始条件须满足速度约束∇·v=0，并由动量方程给出∂t v后满足隐藏约束∇·∂t v=0，从而确定压力；修复方法是在交界处施加压力约束，并把该隐藏约束加入损失函数。
AI.result: 在Re=100时得到涡脱落；Strouhal数和平均阻力系数与同一区域OpenFOAM解在0.5%以内一致；但窗口交界处压力不连续，升力系数呈阶梯状。仅施加压力可使解连续但不一致；同时施加交界压力并加入隐藏约束后，在五个脱落周期内升力系数跳变缩小20倍。
AI.conclusion: 连续时间PINN通过逐时间窗训练、无参考数据和解析无散度初始条件，可以复现圆柱绕流涡脱落；窗口交界处的一致性问题与不可压Navier-Stokes方程的指数2微分代数结构及隐藏约束有关，加入该隐藏约束可显著减小升力跳变。摘要未提供网络结构、窗口长度等实现细节，也未声称压力不连续已被完全消除。

title: Gaussian priors from nonlinear PDEs with the semiclassical approximation
summary: Probabilistic numerical methods for partial differential equations (PDE) combines the governing physics with observations to treat solving the PDE as a Bayesian inverse problem. This allows techniques to quantify the uncertainty in the field reconstruction under model-form error. In the majority of cases, a Gaussian prior is assigned to the field of interest, and Bayes's theorem in the infinite-dimensional setting is used to derive the posterior. While Gaussians have been shown to be well-suited for linear PDEs, a similar treatment for nonlinear PDEs remains open-ended. In this work, study the use of the semiclassical approximation to construct Gaussian priors from variational energies or integrated square residuals for probabilistic numerics. The prior is derived by expanding the PDE energy about a stable solution and uncovering a Gaussian form. We then analyze the different characteristics of the resulting priors as they pertain to the inverse problem. In particular, we find that the covariance operator is given by the inverse of the Hessian of the energy whose associated Cameron-Martin space is the solution space of the PDE. We also find that the prior responds to model-form error by sharpening or flattening itself depending on the distance between the ground truth and the solution of the assumed model.

AI.tldr: 该文研究用半经典近似为偏微分方程的概率数值方法构造高斯先验：将PDE能量在稳定解附近展开得到高斯形式，并分析该先验在贝叶斯反问题中的性质；结果表明协方差算子为能量Hessian的逆，Cameron-Martin空间为PDE解空间，且先验会依模型形式误差调整。摘要未提供数值实验或定量结果。
AI.motivation: 概率数值方法把PDE求解视为贝叶斯反问题，以结合物理模型与观测并量化模型形式误差下的场重构不确定性；现有做法多采用高斯先验并在无穷维设定下用贝叶斯定理求后验，高斯先验对线性PDE较合适，但非线性PDE的对应处理尚无定论，因此需要从能量构造高斯先验的框架。
AI.method: 采用半经典近似，从变分能量或积分平方残差构造高斯先验；将PDE能量在稳定解附近展开，得到高斯形式先验；随后分析所得先验在反问题中的特征，包括协方差算子及Cameron-Martin空间，并考察其对模型形式误差的响应。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，所得先验的协方差算子为能量Hessian的逆，其关联的Cameron-Martin空间是PDE的解空间；先验会响应模型形式误差，依据真值与假设模型解之间的距离而锐化或平坦化。摘要未给出具体数值实验、误差指标或应用案例。
AI.conclusion: 半经典近似可由PDE能量系统构造高斯先验，为非线性PDE的概率数值方法提供具有明确协方差结构与解空间刻画、并能反映模型形式误差的先验选择；但摘要未提供实验验证或与其他先验的定量比较，相关效果仍需进一步研究。

title: A novel quantum lattice Boltzmann methodology for cosmological radiation transport
summary: Radiation transport is an essential process in many physical simulations, including cosmological codes which track stellar and diffuse radiation. Many present codes utilize ray tracing or moment methods, but these grow increasingly difficult and expensive for large simulations. Quantum lattice Boltzmann methods exponentially reduce complexity by propagating radiation over a lattice, allowing for better spatial resolution without needing to introduce adaptive ray tracing or other optimizations. However, existing formulations result in poor angular resolution for radiation point sources. In this work, we propose an angular redistribution methodology which significantly improves the resolution with minimal increase in complexity. We verify the correctness of the method on both classical processors and quantum simulators and outline how the quantum algorithm can be integrated into existing codes. This method is an important step towards fully-quantum radiation hydrodynamics simulation which could exponentially accelerate existing cosmological codes, enabling simulations at scales currently infeasible.

AI.tldr: 该文针对量子格点玻尔兹曼辐射输运方法对点源角分辨率较差的问题，提出一种角向重分配方法，以很小复杂度代价显著提升角分辨率，并在经典处理器和量子模拟器上验证正确性。
AI.motivation: 许多宇宙学模拟需要追踪恒星辐射和漫辐射，但传统射线追踪或矩方法在大规模模拟中成本高、难度大；量子格点玻尔兹曼方法可指数降低复杂度并改善空间分辨率，但现有形式对辐射点源的角分辨率较差。
AI.method: 提出一种角向重分配方法，在仅小幅增加复杂度的情况下改善角分辨率；在经典处理器和量子模拟器上验证方法正确性，并说明如何将该量子算法集成到现有代码中。摘要未提供具体算法步骤、误差指标或复杂度增长的定量细节。
AI.result: 该方法显著提高了对辐射点源的角分辨率，且复杂度增加很小；正确性已在经典处理器和量子模拟器上得到验证，并给出了与现有代码集成的思路。摘要未给出具体分辨率提升倍数或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是迈向全量子辐射流体动力学模拟的重要一步，有望指数加速现有宇宙学代码，从而支持当前不可行的大尺度模拟。

title: Floquet Decomposition: Floquet Multipliers and Time-Periodic Modes from Period-Sampled Snapshot Data
comment: 40 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Applied Dynamical Systems. A companion paper on the fluid dynamics and combustion physics of the experiment is submitted to AIAA Journal
summary: Dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) fits one constant linear operator to a sequence of snapshots. When the dynamics, or the view of them, vary periodically, as in a parametrically excited flow or a rotating structure seen in a fixed plane, no such operator exists, and stability is decided by the Floquet multipliers, the eigenvalues of the map over one period. In the paper that introduced DMD, Schmid observed that snapshots sampled at the period of an oscillatory flow would identify the Floquet matrix. We develop that observation into a method and analyze it. The Floquet decomposition (FD) applies DMD to fixed-rate data subsampled once per period; the ensemble Floquet decomposition (EFD) stacks the snapshots of each period into one column, giving one set of multipliers and phase-resolved modes. For linear time-periodic systems both are exact: FD when the measurement at one instant determines the state, EFD when the measurements over one period do---so EFD succeeds with partial measurements. EFD and Hankel (delay-embedded) DMD use the same data matrix with different shifts between columns. With $p$ samples per period, Hankel-DMD returns each Floquet mode as a carrier with sidebands, a comb of $p$-th roots of its multiplier, which the period shift collapses onto the multiplier. The methods are verified against known multipliers; outside their hypotheses, on nonlinear or noisy data, the estimated moduli are biased and are not decay rates. Measurements of velocity, scalars, and acoustic pressure in a swirl-stabilized combustor illustrate the choice of period, rank, and data scaling.

AI.tldr: 该文将Schmid关于按振荡周期采样可识别Floquet矩阵的观察发展为Floquet分解（FD）与集成Floquet分解（EFD），分析其精确性条件、与Hankel-DMD的关系及在非线性/噪声数据下的偏差，并用旋流稳定燃烧器测量说明实际参数选择。
AI.motivation: DMD用一个恒定线性算子拟合快照序列，但当动力学或其观测视角周期性变化时不存在这样的算子，稳定性应由Floquet乘子（单周期映射的特征值）决定；作者因此把Schmid的观察系统化为方法并进行分析。
AI.method: FD对固定采样率数据每隔一个周期子采样一次后应用DMD；EFD将一个周期内的快照堆叠为一列，得到一组乘子和相位分辨模态。对线性时间周期系统，二者在各自条件下精确：FD要求某一时刻的测量能确定状态，EFD要求一个周期内的测量能确定状态，因此EFD可用于部分测量。EFD与Hankel（延迟嵌入）DMD使用同一数据矩阵但列间移位不同；每周期有p个样本时，Hankel-DMD把每个Floquet模态表示为带边带的载波，即其乘子的p次根组合，而周期移位将其折叠到乘子上。
AI.result: 方法用已知乘子进行了验证；在线性时间周期假设内FD和EFD可精确恢复乘子，EFD在部分测量下仍可成功。超出假设时，在非线性或含噪数据上估计的模值有偏，不能解释为衰减率。对旋流稳定燃烧器中速度、标量和声压的测量展示了周期、秩和数据缩放的选择。
AI.conclusion: FD和EFD将DMD推广到周期变化的动力学或周期观测，并在明确假设下精确识别Floquet乘子和相位分辨模态；实际应用需满足其状态可观测性条件并谨慎选择周期、秩与缩放，非线性和噪声下所得模值不是衰减率。

title: Electrostatic effects on settling cloud droplets: from pair collisions to size distribution evolution
summary: We investigate how droplet charge and a uniform vertical electric field influence collisions between cloud droplets settling in still air and how these collisions shape the droplet size distribution. We compute collision efficiencies by analyzing the relative trajectories of pairs of spherical, conducting droplets, accounting for droplet inertia, exact hydrodynamic, electrostatic, and van der Waals forces. The hydrodynamic interactions are based on exact two-body solutions for Stokes flow with interfacial mobility and internal circulation. In the absence of an applied electric field, collisions between like-charged droplets are suppressed, whereas collisions between oppositely-charged droplets are enhanced. A vertical electric field promotes collisions between uncharged droplets through induced polarization and, when sufficiently strong, can overcome the repulsion between like-charged droplets. When the larger droplet has a radius of $10$ or $20μ$m raising the electric field strength from $5\times10^{4}$ to $3\times10^{5}\,\mathrm{V\,m^{-1}}$ can enhance the collision efficiency of uncharged droplet pairs by an order of magnitude. Depending on droplet size and field strength, for oppositely charged pairs, an applied electric field can either enhance or suppress collisions relative to the zero-field case. Using collision kernels computed from droplet pair trajectories, we solve the stochastic collection equation with a flux method on a two-dimensional grid that resolves droplet mass and charge. For an initial mean droplet radius of $10μ$m , by $40$ min in every electrified case the large-droplet mode of the mass spectrum reaches a larger radius than in the hydrodynamic reference case. This suggests that electrostatic interactions can hasten warm rain initiation by accelerating droplet growth through collision and coalescence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究液滴电荷与均匀垂直电场如何影响静止空气中沉降云滴的碰撞，以及这些碰撞如何塑造液滴粒径分布。作者通过成对液滴轨迹计算碰撞效率，并用碰撞核求解随机收集方程，发现静电力可显著改变碰撞效率并加速大液滴增长，可能促进暖雨启动。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解云滴电荷和垂直电场对沉降云滴碰撞的影响，以及这些碰撞如何影响液滴粒径分布；并评估静电相互作用是否能通过加速碰撞并合促进暖雨启动。
AI.method: 计算球形导电液滴对的相对轨迹以得到碰撞效率，模型中考虑液滴惯性以及精确的流体动力、静电和范德华力；流体相互作用采用带界面迁移率和内部循环的Stokes流精确两体解。随后使用由液滴对轨迹计算得到的碰撞核，在同时解析液滴质量和电荷的二维网格上，用通量法求解随机收集方程。
AI.result: 无外加电场时，同号带电液滴之间的碰撞受到抑制，异号带电液滴之间的碰撞增强。垂直电场可通过诱导极化促进不带电液滴碰撞，且在场强足够强时可克服同号电荷排斥。当较大液滴半径为10或20 μm时，将场强从5×10^4提高到3×10^5 V m^-1，可使不带电液滴对的碰撞效率提高一个数量级。对于异号带电液滴对，电场可依液滴尺寸和场强增强或抑制碰撞。初始平均液滴半径为10 μm时，在所有带电情形下，40 min时质量谱的大液滴模态半径均大于流体动力参考情形。
AI.conclusion: 静电相互作用能够通过碰撞并合加速液滴增长，从而可能加快暖雨启动。摘要未提供更具体的雨启动时间或降水转化率等结论。

title: Pressure demand and solute replacement in a collagen-plugged bioreactor
comment: 24 pages, 9 figures; Supplemental Material (15 pages, 9 figures) included. Data and code: https://github.com/akash312010/bioreactor-collagen-plug
summary: In a perfusion bioreactor, fresh culture medium enters through a small opening, flows through a collagen plug, and leaves through a second opening. How much pressure is needed to sustain that flow? When fresh medium reaches the outlet, has it also replaced the old medium inside the pores? To answer these questions, we simulated flow and medium replacement in pores traced from a collagen image. The flow simulations and curved-channel theory show how narrow, winding passages concentrate resistance. We used that resistance to estimate the plug permeability and found that the modeled plug accounts for most of the pressure drop across the chamber. Feeding through small openings adds to that demand because the flow must spread through the plug and converge again at the outlet. At the same flow rate, this requires about seven times the pressure needed with uniform feeding across the plug faces. Pore shape also affects how closely the outlet signal tracks replacement in the interior. In most runs, the interior reaches 99% replacement before the outlet does. A slowly exchanging side pocket can reverse that order by retaining old medium while fresh medium passes through the main channel. In the strongest case, the interior takes nearly three times as long as the outlet to reach the same replacement threshold.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对灌注生物反应器中培养基流经胶原塞时的压降与孔隙内旧培养基置换问题，基于胶原图像提取孔隙并进行流动与置换模拟，结合弯曲通道理论分析阻力来源，并比较小开口进液与均匀进液及不同孔隙形状对压力需求和出口信号可靠性的影响。
AI.motivation: 作者希望回答两个问题：维持新鲜培养基通过胶原塞所需压力有多大；当新鲜培养基到达出口时，孔隙内部旧培养基是否已被替代。其动机是理解灌注系统中的压降来源以及出口信号能否可靠反映内部培养基置换程度。
AI.method: 研究从胶原图像中追踪孔隙几何，开展流动与培养基置换模拟，并用弯曲通道理论解释狭窄、迂回通道如何集中流动阻力；利用所得阻力估算胶原塞渗透率，并比较通过小开口进液与在塞面均匀进液的压力需求，同时分析孔隙形状对出口信号与内部置换关系的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明，狭窄、迂回的通道会集中阻力；所建模的胶原塞贡献了腔室大部分压降。通过小开口进液时，流动需在塞内扩散并在出口重新汇聚，在相同流量下所需压力约为均匀进液时的7倍。孔隙形状会影响出口信号对内部置换的跟踪：多数运行中，内部先达到99%置换，随后出口才达到；缓慢交换的侧袋可保留旧培养基，使出口先于内部达到阈值，最强情况下内部达到同一置换阈值所需时间接近出口的3倍。
AI.conclusion: 胶原塞的压降和培养基置换受孔隙几何及进液方式显著影响；小开口进液会显著增加压力需求，出口处出现新鲜培养基并不总能可靠代表孔隙内部已完成同等程度置换。摘要未提供具体压力、渗透率或模拟参数数值。

title: Energy cascade spectrum in wave turbulence of a two-dimensional quantum fluid
summary: In the two-dimensional (2D) Gross-Pitaevskii model for a Bose gas, the naive dimensional non-equilibrium wave-turbulence power-law prediction for the direct energy cascade coincides with thermal equilibrium and therefore carries no energy flux. We resolve this degeneracy by deriving a logarithmically corrected spectrum that supports a positive, constant energy flux toward small scales. A systematic asymptotic expansion of the wave-kinetic collision integral determines the logarithmic exponent to be 1/3, while the small-scale dissipation scale sets the upper cutoff in the logarithmic correction. Regularization of a marginal infrared divergence at the forcing scale yields an estimate of the spectral prefactor for asymptotically well-separated forcing and dissipation scales. Simulations of the Gross-Pitaevskii and wave-kinetic equations support the predicted spectral shape. Over finite spectral ranges, the correction produces apparent power laws steeper than the dimensional prediction, offering a possible explanation for the steep spectra observed in 2D Bose gas experiments. Our approach provides a systematic framework for constructing wave turbulent cascade spectra when the power-law prediction is degenerate with thermodynamic equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 该文针对二维 Gross-Pitaevskii 模型中直接能量级联的朴素幂律预测与热平衡重合、因而无能量通量的退化问题，推导出带对数修正的波湍流谱，并用波动力学方程渐近分析与数值模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 在二维 Bose 气体的 Gross-Pitaevskii 模型中，直接能量级联的朴素量纲幂律预测与热平衡谱重合，无法携带能量通量，形成理论退化；作者希望解决该退化，并解释实验中观测到的偏陡谱。
AI.method: 对波动力学碰撞积分进行系统渐近展开，推导带对数修正的谱；确定对数修正指数为 1/3，并由小尺度耗散尺度给出对数修正的上截止；通过正则化 forcing scale 处的边缘红外发散，估计渐近分离的 forcing 与耗散尺度下的谱前因子；同时对 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程和波动力学方程进行模拟。
AI.result: 得到支持向小尺度正且恒定能量通量的对数修正谱；模拟支持预测的谱形；在有限谱范围内，该修正产生比量纲预测更陡的表观幂律，为二维 Bose 气体实验中观测到的陡谱提供可能解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为幂律预测与热力学平衡退化时的波湍流级联谱构建提供了系统框架，并可能解释二维 Bose 气体实验中的陡谱现象。

title: Remote and Noncontact Acceleration and Suppression of Heat Convection on Object Surfaces using Intensity-Adjusted Acoustic Streaming
summary: The temperature of objects in an environment is often controlled by accelerating or suppressing heat convection. Conventional methods generally involve insulation for heat retention and forced convection for cooling. However, there is no practical method for remotely and target-selectively controlling heat convection in objects in room environments. In this study, we demonstrated that intensity-adjusted acoustic streaming (ultrasound-driven airflow) can both suppress natural convection and induce forced convection on the surface of a heat source. The direct acceleration and deceleration of air over the object surface were induced by an ultrasonic beam with high temporal and spatial resolution. The experiment showed that it is possible to switch between insulating and cooling by adjusting the ultrasonic output intensity, and that it is essential for heat retention to prevent heat from escaping from the object surface by convection using acoustic streaming. We consider these results to lead to the realization of a situation where virtual heat-retaining blankets or cooling fans that are customized for specific objects in the environment can be ubiquitously attached to them, opening the door to applications such as temperature control of food and beverages and remote control of temperature profiles in manufacturing processes and laboratory settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用强度可调的超声声流（超声驱动气流）在热源表面抑制自然对流并诱导强制对流，从而通过调节超声输出强度实现保温与冷却的切换，并讨论了其在食品饮料温控及制造和实验场景远程温度调控中的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 物体温度常通过加速或抑制热对流来控制，但传统方法主要依赖保温隔热和强制对流冷却，缺乏在室内环境中对物体进行远程、目标选择性热对流控制的实用方法。
AI.method: 采用强度可调的声流（超声驱动的气流），利用具有高时间与空间分辨率的超声束直接加速或减速物体表面的空气，以抑制自然对流或诱导强制对流，并通过实验调节超声输出强度。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法可同时抑制自然对流并在热源表面诱导强制对流；通过调节超声输出强度可在保温与冷却之间切换；保温的关键在于利用声流阻止热量从物体表面通过对流散失。
AI.conclusion: 强度可调的声流有望实现可针对环境中特定物体“附着”的虚拟保温毯或冷却风扇，为食品和饮料温度控制以及制造过程和实验室环境中的远程温度分布调控提供应用可能。

title: BridgeSRDA: Efficient Probabilistic Super-Resolution Data Assimilation with Forecast-Informed Stochastic Interpolants
summary: High-resolution ensemble data assimilation is computationally demanding because it requires repeated forecasts and updates of many flow states. We introduce BridgeSRDA, a probabilistic super-resolution data assimilation framework that combines low-resolution numerical forecasts with sparse, noisy observations to generate high-resolution analysis windows. A neural network learns forecast-informed stochastic transport, which is sampled to produce an ensemble of reconstructions. Each current analysis initializes the next low-resolution forecast, while the same window provides retrospective reconstructions and short-range nowcasts. We evaluate BridgeSRDA over ten independently initialized trajectories of a three-dimensional quasi-geostrophic flow in a narrow-jet regime different from training. At the training observation spacing, BridgeSRDA approaches the mean and structural reconstruction accuracy of a high-resolution local ensemble transform Kalman filter and reduces the mean absolute error ratio by approximately 32.5% relative to deterministic four-dimensional SRDA. With 30 ensemble members, BridgeSRDA requires approximately 17 s per analysis, compared with 31 s for the filter under the recorded conditions. Ten members reduce the cost to approximately 6.6 s with little change in mean accuracy, though fine-scale accuracy and interval coverage are affected. BridgeSRDA achieves a competitive continuous ranked probability score, but its ensembles are underdispersed: nominal 90% intervals contain approximately 62% of reference values. Boundary spread artifacts and reduced skill under sparser observations also warrant attention. These results demonstrate the potential of forecast-informed stochastic transport for probabilistic data assimilation, while highlighting the need to improve uncertainty calibration and robustness to changing observation networks.

AI.tldr: BridgeSRDA 是一种概率超分辨率数据同化框架，利用神经网络学习由预报信息驱动的随机输运，将低分辨率数值预报与稀疏含噪观测结合，生成高分辨率分析集合。在三维准地转窄急流区制的10条独立轨迹上，其平均/结构精度接近高分辨率LETKF，较确定性四维SRDA降低约32.5%的MAE比；30成员每分析约17 s，快于LETKF的31 s，10成员约6.6 s且平均精度变化不大，但细尺度精度和区间覆盖率受影响。CRPS有竞争力，但集合欠离散，名义90%区间仅覆盖约62%参考值，且存在边界扩散伪影和稀疏观测下技能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率集合数据同化需反复预报并更新大量流状态，计算代价高；作者希望以概率超分辨率数据同化，将低分辨率数值预报与稀疏、含噪观测结合，低成本生成高分辨率分析窗口。
AI.method: 提出BridgeSRDA：神经网络学习由预报信息驱动的随机输运，并通过采样产生重建集合；当前分析用于初始化下一次低分辨率预报，同一窗口还提供回溯重建和短期临近预报。在三维准地转窄急流区制、与训练不同的10条独立初始化轨迹上评估，并与高分辨率局部集合变换卡尔曼滤波及确定性四维SRDA比较；摘要未提供网络结构、训练损失和观测同化细节。
AI.result: 在训练观测间距下，BridgeSRDA的平均和结构重建精度接近高分辨率LETKF，平均绝对误差比较确定性四维SRDA降低约32.5%。30个集合成员时每次分析约17 s，LETKF在记录条件下约31 s；10个成员约6.6 s，平均精度变化不大，但细尺度精度和区间覆盖率受影响。其连续排序概率分数有竞争力，但集合欠离散，名义90%区间约含62%参考值；边界扩散伪影和观测更稀疏时技能下降也需关注。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，由预报信息驱动的随机输运用于概率数据同化具有潜力，但需改进不确定性校准，并提升对观测网络变化的稳健性。

title: Azimuthally Resolved Energy Dissipation Rates in the Impingement Zone of Equal Free Impinging Liquid Jets: A Three-Dimensional Model
summary: When two equal liquid jets collide, they form a thin sheet of liquid and lose some of their incoming kinetic energy (doi:10.1615/AtomizSpr.2025056396). Calculating the energy dissipation rate per unit mass requires estimating the volume of the region where the collision takes place. This paper develops a three-dimensional model of that region and uses it to calculate how the energy dissipation rate varies with angular position within the collision region. The model assumes that the thickness of the collision region varies linearly along each radial line from the stagnation point to its outer boundary. Combining the resulting volume with the kinetic energy lost during the collision provides equations for both the overall energy dissipation rate and the rate averaged over each narrow angular portion of the collision region (local energy dissipation rate). For equal jets with uniform inlet velocity profiles, the model predicts substantial differences in energy dissipation rate with angular position, even when the incoming jets and the resulting sheet have uniform mean velocities. The model also reproduces expected theoretical limits, including a cylindrical collision region for directly opposed jets. Preliminary micromixing results are consistent with the predicted variation, although independent validation of the assumed collision-region geometry and the location of energy dissipation is still needed.

AI.tldr: 针对等速液体射流碰撞形成薄液片并损失动能的问题，本文建立碰撞区三维体积模型，推导总体与局部能量耗散率表达式，预测能量耗散率随角向位置显著变化，并获得与初步微混合结果一致的趋势，但碰撞区几何与能量耗散位置仍需独立验证。
AI.motivation: 计算单位质量能量耗散率需要估计射流碰撞区域的体积，并需要描述该区域内能量耗散率随角向位置的变化。
AI.method: 建立碰撞区域的三维模型，假设碰撞区厚度沿每条从驻点到外边界的径向线线性变化；将所得体积与碰撞过程中损失的动能结合，推导总体能量耗散率及每个窄角扇区平均的局部能量耗散率方程；针对具有均匀入口速度剖面的等速射流进行分析。
AI.result: 模型预测：即使入射射流和形成液片的平均速度均匀，能量耗散率随角向位置仍存在显著差异；模型再现预期理论极限，包括直接对撞射流形成圆柱形碰撞区；初步微混合结果与预测的角向变化一致。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 该模型可用于估算碰撞区体积并计算总体与局部能量耗散率，揭示角向非均匀性并符合部分理论极限；但所假设的碰撞区几何及能量耗散位置仍需独立验证。

title: Anomalous scaling of coalescence in a Hele-Shaw cell
summary: We investigate the merging of two drops between two narrowly spaced plates, a so-called Hele-Shaw cell. For this, we solve the Hele-Shaw equations in two dimensions, driven by surface tension, focusing on early times after initial reconnection. Combining numerical simulations with theory, we show that the coalescence dynamics are self-similar at early times, with the size of the contact region between the drops growing as $t^{3/13}$. We find this power law using a matched asymptotic analysis, which reveals a complex geometry consisting of a small bubble that gets entrained between the drops as they come together. These predictions match perfectly to our simulations, and agree with the most recent experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究窄间距平板（Hele-Shaw cell）间两个液滴的早期合并动力学，结合二维数值模拟与匹配渐近理论，发现初始重连后接触区尺寸按 t^{3/13} 自相似增长，并揭示液滴间夹带小气泡的复杂几何；预测与模拟及最新实验数据吻合。
AI.motivation: 研究两液滴在狭窄平板间合并、尤其是初始重连后早期由表面张力驱动的动力学，以确定合并过程是否自相似以及接触区生长规律。摘要未提供更广泛的应用动机。
AI.method: 求解二维Hele-Shaw方程并进行数值模拟，聚焦初始重连后的早期阶段；同时采用匹配渐近分析推导标度律，并分析合并过程中液滴之间夹带小气泡的几何结构。
AI.result: 接触区域尺寸随时间的增长为 t^{3/13}，表明早期合并动力学具有自相似性；理论预测与数值模拟完全吻合，并与最新实验数据一致。
AI.conclusion: 两液滴在Hele-Shaw cell中的早期合并由自相似动力学支配，接触区按 t^{3/13} 增长，其机制包含液滴靠近时夹带的小气泡；理论、模拟与实验相互验证。

title: Point vortex dynamics influenced by the surface motion
summary:
We study a coupled system of differential equations, which models the dynamics of fluid with a free surface and a point vortex in the body of the fluid. For long surface waves of small amplitude, the effects of the interaction between the waves and the point vortex are modeled within the framework of the Boussinesq regime.
  It turns out that the solitary waves on the surface are not destroyed by the interaction with the vortex, and, as a matter of fact, the solitary waves remain practically unaffected for a significant range of the vortex strength. As a result, a further simplification of the model is proposed, where the vortex motion under solitons propagating on the surface is determined from a system of decoupled ordinary differential equations.

AI.tldr: 该文研究自由表面流体与流体内部点涡相互作用的耦合微分方程模型，在Boussinesq近似下分析小振幅长表面波与点涡的相互作用，发现孤立波在较大涡旋强度范围内几乎不受影响，并提出用解耦常微分方程描述涡旋在表面孤立波下方的运动。
AI.motivation: 研究对象是带自由表面的流体与流体内部点涡的耦合动力学；针对小振幅长表面波，作者希望在Boussinesq框架内刻画表面波与点涡的相互作用，并判断这种相互作用是否会破坏表面孤立波。
AI.method: 建立并研究描述自由表面流体与点涡动力学的耦合微分方程组；在小振幅长波条件下采用Boussinesq近似建模；分析表面孤立波与点涡的相互作用，并据此提出模型简化，将涡旋运动表示为解耦的常微分方程组。摘要未给出方程的具体形式、参数范围及推导细节。
AI.result: 分析表明，表面孤立波不会因与点涡相互作用而被破坏；在相当大的涡旋强度范围内，孤立波实际上几乎不受影响。基于这一结果，作者提出进一步简化模型，使涡旋在表面孤子下方的运动由解耦常微分方程组确定。
AI.conclusion: 表面孤立波与点涡的相互作用在Boussinesq框架下不会破坏孤立波，且在其显著强度范围内影响很小；因此可将原耦合模型简化为解耦常微分方程来描述涡旋在传播孤子下方的运动。摘要未提供定量阈值或实验/数值验证细节。

title: Basin-Scale Nonlinear Dynamics of Thermohaline Ocean Circulation. Part I: Theory
summary: Earth's thermohaline ocean circulation may support multiple equilibria and abrupt transitions. Similar bifurcation structures for different ocean models suggest common underlying dynamics across the model hierarchy. Here we propose a unifying framework from tracer conservation, in which surface fluxes are balanced by dissipative and advective tracer transport. We express this flux balance through a large-scale tracer gradient and a transport efficiency that measures how strongly circulation displaces the tracer field from its no-flow "conductive" state. The flux balance quantifies the transport contributions that sustain each circulation state and give rise to abrupt transitions. In a three-dimensional ocean-basin model, we find nonlinear salinity advection dominates the collapse threshold and linear dissipation dominates the recovery threshold. Temperature has additional dissipation from surface restoring, making thermal fluxes more dissipation-dominated than salinity fluxes. The tracer contrasts and boundary layers that a given circulation generates produce distinct transport regimes, approximately quadratic in circulation strength for weak flow and linear for strong flow. With a simple circulation closure, the flux balance reduces to longstanding box-model bifurcation results for the weak and strong flow regimes. Thus, by expressing thermohaline bifurcations through basin-scale transport, this framework connects box-model insight to the continuous equations. Furthermore, as this framework exposes the transport processes that balance a changing forcing, it provides constraints on a thermohaline ocean state and its trend toward tipping that overturning strength alone does not. In Part II, we develop flux-balance closures to forecast such tipping points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于示踪物守恒的通量平衡框架，用大尺度示踪物梯度与输运效率描述热盐环流的多平衡和突变；三维海盆模型表明盐度非线性平流主导崩溃阈值、线性耗散主导恢复阈值，并可将箱模型分岔结果与连续方程联系起来，为海洋状态趋向临界转变提供约束。
AI.motivation: 热盐环流可能具有多平衡态和突变，不同海洋模型出现相似分岔结构，暗示模型层级间存在共同动力学。作者希望建立统一框架，将箱模型洞见与连续方程连接，并识别平衡变化强迫的输运过程，从而给出仅靠翻转强度无法提供的海洋状态及其趋向临界转变的约束。
AI.method: 从示踪物守恒出发，提出表面通量由耗散和平流示踪物输运平衡的框架；用大尺度示踪物梯度和输运效率（环流使示踪场偏离无流动“传导”态的程度）表达通量平衡。在三维海洋海盆模型中分析盐度和温度通量，并采用简单环流闭合，将该通量平衡化为弱流和强流情形下既有箱模型分岔结果。
AI.result: 三维海盆模型中，非线性盐度平流主导崩溃阈值，线性耗散主导恢复阈值；温度因表面恢复存在额外耗散，使热通量比盐度通量更受耗散主导。给定环流产生的示踪物对比和边界层形成不同输运区间：弱流近似二次依赖环流强度，强流近似线性。简单环流闭合下，通量平衡退化为弱流和强流情形的既有箱模型分岔结果。摘要未给出具体定量阈值或参数值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过海盆尺度输运表达热盐分岔，将箱模型洞见与连续方程连接；由于揭示平衡变化强迫的输运过程，它可约束热盐海洋状态及其趋向临界转变的趋势，提供仅靠翻转强度不能给出的信息。第二部分将发展通量平衡闭合以预报此类临界转变点。

title: Voltage-Enhanced Photorefractive Hysteresis in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic-Crystal Cavities
summary: We observe voltage-enhanced photorefractive hysteresis in thin-film lithium niobate nanocavities, causing the resonance to appear at different wavelengths during increasing- and decreasing-wavelength laser scans. Their separation grows with bias magnitude and optical power, but depends weakly on scan speed over 1-200 nm/s. A quasi-static surface-trap model links voltage-biased carrier transport to asymmetric trapping, whose space-charge field shifts the resonance through the Pockels effect. The model captures this hysteresis across three cavities through switching between stable steady states. Space-charge feedback opposes further carrier separation, limiting the hysteresis gap. The model informs photorefractive mitigation and resonance control in integrated electro-optic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究薄膜铌酸锂纳米腔中由电压增强的光折变迟滞：正反扫描时共振出现在不同波长，间隔随偏压和光功率增大，在1–200 nm/s扫描速度范围内依赖较弱；准静态表面陷阱模型用空间电荷场经Pockels效应解释该现象。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确给出研究动机；其关注点在于观测并建模该迟滞，以服务于集成电光器件中的光折变抑制与共振控制。
AI.method: 采用准静态表面陷阱模型，将电压偏置下的载流子输运与不对称俘获联系起来，并由空间电荷场通过Pockels效应导致共振偏移；模型通过稳定稳态之间的切换描述迟滞。
AI.result: 实验观测到电压增强的光折变迟滞，正反波长扫描的共振间隔随偏压幅度和光功率增大，而对1–200 nm/s扫描速度依赖较弱；模型在三个腔体中捕捉到该迟滞，并表明空间电荷反馈会抑制载流子进一步分离，从而限制迟滞间隔。
AI.conclusion: 该模型可解释薄膜铌酸锂纳米腔中的光折变迟滞，并为集成电光器件中的光折变缓解和共振控制提供依据。

title: A Reconfigurable Four-State Sensor Based on Orthogonal Thermal and Chemical Stimuli
summary: This article presents a novel four-state refractive index (RI) sensor based on distinct phases of palladium (Pd) and vanadium dioxide (VO$_2$), controlled by orthogonal thermal and chemical stimuli. This is a numerical, simulation-only study: all results are obtained from two-dimensional finite-element method (FEM) simulations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported multi-state reconfigurable RI sensor tuned by external control. VO$_2$ serves as a phase change material (PCM) offering two thermally switchable phases with highly contrasting optical properties, while the hydrogen absorption property of Pd provides two additional phases. Combining these, four operational states are realized: (i) $α$-Pd/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (ii) $β$-PdH$_x$/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (iii) $α$-Pd/high-$T$ VO$_2$; and (iv) $β$-PdH$_x$/high-$T$ VO$_2$. Thermal crosstalk between Pd and VO$_2$ is mitigated through tungsten (W) doping of VO$_2$. This work further introduces conditional state sensitivity (CSS), a novel figure of merit quantifying the optical contrast between each state transition. The proposed sensor achieves a peak sensitivity of 2871 nm/RIU for the undoped reference configuration and 2798 nm/RIU for the practical W-doped device, together with a peak CSS of 16,872 nm/RIU, establishing it as a multi-state reconfigurable platform with reduced thermal crosstalk and potential applications in industrial safety monitoring and optical logic gates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并数值研究了一种基于Pd与VO2不同相态、由正交热与化学刺激控制的四态可重构折射率传感器；采用二维FEM仿真，实现四种工作状态，并引入条件状态灵敏度（CSS）作为新指标，W掺杂VO2用于抑制热串扰；未掺杂与W掺杂器件的峰值灵敏度分别为2871和2798 nm/RIU，峰值CSS为16,872 nm/RIU。
AI.motivation: 旨在据作者所知首次报道一种由外部控制调谐的多态可重构折射率传感器。其动机是利用VO2的热致相变和Pd的氢吸收特性，在同一平台上获得四种可切换状态，并通过W掺杂VO2减轻Pd与VO2之间的热串扰，同时提出量化状态转换光学对比度的新指标CSS。
AI.method: 本研究为纯数值仿真研究，所有结果均来自二维有限元法（FEM）仿真。VO2作为相变材料提供低温和高温两种热切换相，Pd利用氢吸收提供α-Pd与β-PdHx两种状态，组合形成四种工作状态：α-Pd/低温VO2、β-PdHx/低温VO2、α-Pd/高温VO2、β-PdHx/高温VO2。通过对VO2进行W掺杂抑制热串扰，并引入条件状态灵敏度（CSS）用于量化各状态转换之间的光学对比度。
AI.result: 所提出传感器在未掺杂参考配置中达到2871 nm/RIU的峰值灵敏度，在实际W掺杂器件中达到2798 nm/RIU的峰值灵敏度，同时获得16,872 nm/RIU的峰值CSS。结果基于二维FEM仿真，摘要未提供实验验证数据。
AI.conclusion: 该器件构成一种多态可重构折射率传感平台，具有降低热串扰的特点，并有望应用于工业安全监测和光学逻辑门。摘要未提供其他结论或实验结论。

title: Blind spatially varying PSF estimation for fluorescence microscopy
summary: Optical aberrations degrade fluorescence microscopy images and measuring the underlying point spread function (PSF) often requires dedicated acquisitions or isolated emitters. Here we introduce DeepBlur, a neural network that estimates spatially varying two-dimensional PSFs directly from single images of biological structures. Trained entirely on physical simulations spanning aberrations, illumination and noise, it adapts to diverse imaging conditions without requiring user-supplied optical parameters. Using a deformable mirror, we acquire 1,290 images and assess blind PSF estimates against independent references. DeepBlur estimates agree closely with these references and improve deconvolution of experimentally aberrated images. Local PSF estimation also enables correction of spatially varying defocus and improves random-illumination super-resolution reconstruction in biological tissue. Available through DeepInv, a napari plugin and a web demonstration, DeepBlur can be readily integrated into computational microscopy workflows.

AI.tldr: DeepBlur 是一个神经网络，可从生物结构的单张图像中估计空间变化二维 PSF；它无需用户提供光学参数，基于物理模拟训练，并在实验像差图像上验证，可改进去卷积、空间变化离焦校正和随机照明超分辨重建。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微图像受光学像差影响，而测量底层点扩散函数通常需要专门采集或孤立发光体，流程复杂且受限。
AI.method: 提出 DeepBlur 神经网络，直接从生物结构单张图像估计空间变化二维 PSF；训练完全基于涵盖像差、照明和噪声的物理模拟，无需用户输入光学参数；使用变形镜采集 1,290 张图像，并将盲 PSF 估计与独立参考比较；通过 DeepInv、napari 插件和网页演示提供。
AI.result: DeepBlur 估计与独立参考高度一致，并改善实验像差图像的去卷积；局部 PSF 估计还能校正空间变化离焦，并改善生物组织中的随机照明超分辨重建。
AI.conclusion: DeepBlur 可 readily 集成到计算显微工作流中，为无需专门 PSF 采集的像差感知显微图像处理提供实用工具。

title: Tunable Terahertz Bandpass Filter based on the Photonic Emulation of a 2DEG Interferometer through the Geometric Phase of Light
summary: Terahertz frequencies are expected to become a key player in next-generation wireless communications. For this transition to occur seamlessly, tunable bandpass filters for channel selection are essential. However, conventional Fabry-Pérot cavity-based bandpass filters face inherent limitations. Specifically, their tunability is restricted by physical constraints, such as the maximum achievable mirror separation. In this work, drawing inspiration from electronic interferometers, we demonstrate a continuously tunable bandpass filter operating near 0.3 THz by exploiting the geometric phase of light, the Pancharatnam-Berry phase. Our device incorporates intracavity waveplates for polarization control and is described by a mathematical expression analogous to that of the electronic interferometer governed by the Aharonov-Bohm phase, thereby realizing a photonic analogue. Using custom-designed subwavelength waveplates and cavity mirrors, we achieve a finesse of $\mathcal{F}\approx17$, a quality factor of $Q\approx1.5\times10^{3}$, and a resonance linewidth of $Δf_{\mathrm{FWHM}}\approx 200$ MHz. Beyond terahertz communication technology, this system is expected to find applications in fields requiring high frequency resolution, such as spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 该文面向太赫兹通信中的可调带通滤波需求，利用Pancharatnam-Berry几何相位构建近0.3 THz的连续可调带通滤波器，以规避传统Fabry-Pérot腔滤波器受镜间距等物理约束的可调性限制，并实现F≈17、Q≈1.5×10^3、Δf_FWHM≈200 MHz。
AI.motivation: 太赫兹频率有望成为下一代无线通信的关键组成部分，而无缝过渡需要用于信道选择的可调带通滤波器。传统基于Fabry-Pérot腔的带通滤波器存在固有局限，其可调性受最大可实现镜间距等物理约束限制。
AI.method: 借鉴电子干涉仪，利用光的几何相位即Pancharatnam-Berry相位，在约0.3 THz实现连续可调带通滤波器。器件包含用于偏振控制的腔内波片，其数学描述类似于受Aharonov-Bohm相位支配的电子干涉仪，从而构成光子学类比；研究采用定制设计的亚波长波片和腔镜。
AI.result: 实现了近0.3 THz的连续可调带通滤波器，获得精细度F≈17、品质因数Q≈1.5×10^3、谐振线宽Δf_FWHM≈200 MHz。
AI.conclusion: 除太赫兹通信技术外，该系统预计还可用于需要高频率分辨率的领域，例如光谱学。摘要未提供更多关于具体应用验证或商业化细节。

title: Theory of Observability of Voigt-Wave Propagation in a Homogeneous Dielectric Material
summary:
A Voigt wave can propagate in a dissipative anisotropic dielectric material when a 4$\times$4 propagation matrix is defective, as happens for a uniform plane wave along a singular axis, and the field depends on the propagation distance linearly as well as exponentially. Whether it is observable outside a slab of that material generally depends on whether the defectiveness is inherited by the 2$\times$2 reflection and transmission matrices, which are extracted from the 2$\times$2 blocks of a 4$\times$4 transfer matrix that relates the fields at the two faces of the slab. Explicit tests exist for each type of defectiveness, and a counting argument shows that excitation and observability co-occur at oblique incidence only for isolated combinations of constitutive parameters and slab thickness. Normal incidence is exceptional: Voigt-wave excitation then generally implies a defective transmission matrix for almost all thicknesses, which explains Voigt's 1902 experiment on andalusite. Numerical searches for andalusite, $β$-gallium oxide, terbium orthoaluminate
  in a magnetostatic field, and hexagonal boron nitride show that a Voigt wave may be excited without being observable and that a defective reflection or transmission matrix need not signal the excitation of a Voigt wave.

AI.tldr: 本文研究耗散各向异性介质板中Voigt波的激发与其在板外可观测性之间的关系：以4×4传播/转移矩阵及由其2×2块得到的反射、透射矩阵的亏损性为判据，结合计数论证与数值搜索表明，Voigt波被激发并不保证可观测，反射或透射矩阵亏损也不必然意味着Voigt波被激发；正入射是例外，可解释Voigt 1902年红柱石实验。
AI.motivation: Voigt波源于4×4传播矩阵亏损，但其能否在介质板外被观测取决于2×2反射和透射矩阵是否继承该亏损性。作者旨在建立激发与可观测性之间的联系，厘清斜入射与正入射条件，并解释历史实验及不同材料中的表现。
AI.method: 从连接介质板两表面场的4×4转移矩阵中提取2×2块，构造反射和透射矩阵；采用针对各类亏损性的显式检验，并用计数论证分析斜入射下激发与可观测性共同出现的条件；对正入射单独分析；对红柱石、β-氧化镓、磁静场中的铽正交铝酸盐和六方氮化硼进行数值搜索。摘要未给出具体矩阵形式、参数范围或数值算法细节。
AI.result: 斜入射时，激发与可观测性仅在孤立的材料本构参数与板厚组合下同时出现；正入射时，Voigt波激发通常在几乎所有厚度下导致透射矩阵亏损，从而解释Voigt 1902年红柱石实验。数值搜索显示，Voigt波可被激发但不可观测，且反射或透射矩阵亏损不一定指示Voigt波激发。摘要未提供具体数值结果或定量比较。
AI.conclusion: Voigt波的激发与外部可观测性不是等价性质，需分别检验4×4传播矩阵和2×2反射/透射矩阵的亏损性。正入射具有特殊行为，而斜入射需满足严格的参数与厚度条件；多材料数值搜索支持上述区分。摘要未给出适用性边界或新的实验验证细节。

title: Arbitrarily Weak Losses Destroy Fractal Bandstructure in Temporal Fibonacci Quasicrystals
summary:
Lossless photonic crystals with weak refractive index contrasts block limited frequencies. However, the same materials arranged in a non-periodic Fibonacci quasicrystal block all but infinitely rare fractally-distributed frequencies. Similar analysis shows that weak quasiperiodic refractive index variation in time should achieve infinitely broadband gain.
  We demonstrate that any small experimental losses immediately destroy this effect. Our methods also provide smoothness and approximation theorems for the localisation lengths central to topology in spatial problems.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，无损耗、弱折射率对比的光子晶体仅能阻挡有限频率；斐波那契准晶可阻挡除极稀有分形分布频率外的所有频率。类似分析预测，时间上弱的准周期折射率变化可实现无限宽带增益，但作者证明任何微小实验损耗都会立即破坏该效应，并给出与空间问题中拓扑相关的局域长度有关的平滑性和逼近定理。
AI.motivation: 检验基于无损耗假设预测的“时间准周期折射率变化实现无限宽带增益”在现实实验损耗下是否稳健，并为空间问题中与拓扑相关的局域长度提供数学工具。
AI.method: 基于对光子晶体和斐波那契准晶频率阻挡行为的类似分析，研究时间上弱准周期折射率变化；并通过理论推导证明微小损耗对该效应的影响，同时建立局域长度的平滑性与逼近定理。摘要未给出具体模型参数、证明步骤或数值方法。
AI.result: 在理想无损耗情形下，弱准周期时间折射率变化被预测可实现无限宽带增益；但任何微小的实验损耗都会立即破坏这一效应。作者的方法还给出了空间问题中局域长度的平滑性与逼近定理。
AI.conclusion: 该无限宽带增益预测对损耗极其敏感，在存在实验损耗时不成立，因而其实际可行性受到根本限制；同时，所发展的数学定理为空间拓扑相关问题中的局域长度分析提供了支持。

title: Solitons as conversion events in quadratic crystals
summary: In a $χ^{(2)}$ crystal with temporal walk-off and negligible dispersion, signal, idler and pump pulses obey the integrable three-wave interaction. For a pump of intermediate group velocity we describe each soliton as a conversion event: the fusion of a signal--idler pair into a pump pulse, or the decay of a pump pulse, at a definite depth in the crystal. The asymptotic $\mathrm{sech}$ pulses, usually treated with three separate $2\times2$ scattering problems, are the legs of the event, a single pole of the $3\times3$ problem. For one event we give the conversion curve in closed form and the minimum crystal length; for several events, the rule by which they displace each other. A pump pulse is unstable, and its growing mode is the tail of a decay event: a seed carrying a fraction $\varepsilon$ of the photons along this mode makes the pulse decay after $Γ^{-1}\ln(c_+/\varepsilon)$, with $Γ$ the conversion rate and $c_+$ of order one. Unmatched signal and idler pulses form the resonance of Kaup, Reiman and Bers; we show that it is a fusion followed by a decay, each within a conversion length, and give its pump photon number in closed form. Since the delay between the input pulses sets the depth of the vertex, these quantities can be read on the output face of a single crystal; we give the scales for periodically poled KTiOPO$_4$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究具有时间走离、色散可忽略的χ^(2)晶体中信号、闲频与泵浦脉冲所满足的可积三波相互作用，将孤子描述为确定深度处的转换事件（信号-闲频对融合为泵浦或泵浦衰变），用3×3散射问题的单一极点统一描述渐近sech脉冲，并给出单事件转换曲线与最小晶体长度、多事件位移规则、泵浦不稳定性增长模式、Kaup-Reiman-Bers共振的融合-衰变图像及周期极化KTiOPO4中的尺度。
AI.motivation: 摘要未直接说明研究动机；从内容可推断，其动机是超越通常用三个独立2×2散射问题处理渐近sech脉冲的做法，以统一描述χ^(2)晶体中孤子的融合/衰变转换事件、泵浦不稳定性及信号-闲频共振，并利用输入脉冲延迟在单一晶体输出端面读取相关物理量。
AI.method: 在时间走离且色散可忽略的χ^(2)晶体中，将信号、闲频和泵浦脉冲作为可积三波相互作用处理；把每个孤子视为确定晶体深度处的转换事件，并用3×3散射问题的单一极点描述其渐近sech脉冲。对单事件给出转换曲线闭式与最小晶体长度，对多事件给出相互位移规则；分析泵浦不稳定性及其增长模式与衰变事件尾部的关系；将Kaup-Reiman-Bers共振解释为一次融合后接一次衰变，并给出泵浦光子数闭式；最后给出周期极化KTiOPO4的尺度。

title: Producing and Measuring Circularly Polarized X-rays: A Jones and Mueller-Stokes Treatment of Crystal Phase Plates
summary:
Converting a linearly polarized X-ray beam into a circularly polarized one, and then verifying the polarization state actually delivered, are standard operations at synchrotron radiation facilities. The key optical element is a quarter-wave plate (QWP), a birefringent crystal that introduces a 90-degree (quarter-wavelength) phase retardation between the two orthogonal components of the electric field.
  This paper presents a self-contained theoretical treatment of X-ray polarization optics. We first establish the Jones and Mueller-Stokes formalisms and their connection via the Pauli matrices, fixing the sign and handedness conventions explicitly and reconciling them with those used elsewhere in the literature. From there we derive the Jones and Mueller matrices of a general retarder at an arbitrary orientation angle chi (including the QWP that converts horizontal linear polarization into circular polarization of either handedness) and of linear polarizers, and describe the experimental Stokes polarimetry protocol used at synchrotron beamlines. These results are then combined to treat the general crystal phase plate, characterized by two complex reflection (or transmission) amplitudes r_s and r_p, obtaining the degree of circular polarization delivered for an arbitrary incident beam as a function of chi and the phase retardation delta. Finally, we turn to the practical implementation of these elements with perfect-crystal diffraction: the residual polarization impurity of a Brewster-angle polarizer and the role of ray tracing in evaluating it, and the choice of diffraction geometry (Bragg or Laue, diffracted or transmitted beam) for obtaining a significant, controllable phase shift. The formalism presented here is the mathematical background of the treatment of polarization in the ray-tracing code SHADOW4.

AI.tldr: 本文系统建立了X射线偏振光学的一种自洽理论框架：以Jones与Mueller-Stokes形式及其通过Pauli矩阵的联系为基础，推导任意取向角χ的延迟器和线偏振器的矩阵，并用于描述晶体相位板、圆形偏振度、Brewster角偏振器与完美晶体衍射几何，最终作为SHADOW4光线追迹代码中偏振处理的数学基础。
AI.motivation: 将线偏振X射线转换为圆偏振并验证实际偏振态是同步辐射装置的标准操作，其中四分之一波片（QWP）是关键光学元件；为此需要一个自洽的理论处理，明确并协调符号与手性约定，并支撑SHADOW4中的偏振建模。
AI.method: 建立Jones与Mueller-Stokes形式及其通过Pauli矩阵的联系，明确符号和手性约定并与文献协调；推导任意取向角χ的一般延迟器（包括将水平线偏振转换为任一手性圆偏振的QWP）和线偏振器的Jones与Mueller矩阵；描述同步辐射光束线使用的实验Stokes偏振测量协议；组合这些结果处理由两个复反射或透射振幅r_s和r_p表征的一般晶体相位板，给出任意入射光束在给定χ和相位延迟δ下获得的圆偏振度；并讨论完美晶体衍射的实际实现，包括Brewster角偏振器的残余偏振杂质及光线追迹在其评估中的作用，以及选择Bragg或Laue、衍射束或透射束以获得显著且可控相移。
AI.result: 摘要给出了完整的理论推导与形式体系，包括QWP、一般延迟器、线偏振器、晶体相位板和Stokes偏振测量协议的处理，并明确协调了符号与手性约定；摘要未提供具体数值或实验测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的形式体系构成了在SHADOW4光线追迹代码中处理偏振问题的数学背景，并为同步辐射中QWP、晶体相位板及完美晶体衍射偏振元件的实际实现与评估提供理论基础。

title: Unveiling gauge-invariant on-chip phases from light intensity
summary: Physics-informed digital twins fitted to output powers increasingly program photonic processors, but these powers do not fix the implemented phase, which determines how light from different inputs interferes. Here we show that a twin trained on intensities alone predicts the gauge-invariant phase of programmed transformations, and that this prediction can be used to program the phase. On a $12\times12$ mesh, with phases measured by interference protocols formed by the mesh itself, intensity-only and phase-aware programs from random starts reach the same intensity fidelity but phase fidelities of 0.690 and 0.996, both as predicted by the twin. The prediction holds for blocks up to $10\times10$. With coherent inputs, the programmed phase determines the outputs: phase-aware programming reduces the direction-of-arrival error of an on-chip Butler matrix from 29 degrees to 2.0 degrees. Power measurements alone thus yield a phase-calibrated model of the mesh, without phase data in training or optics beyond the chip.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种仅用输出光强训练的物理信息数字孪生，可预测并用于编程光子网格的规范不变相位；在12×12网格上实现高相位保真度，并在片上Butler矩阵中将到达方向误差从29度降至2.0度。
AI.motivation: 光子处理器 increasingly 通过拟合输出功率的物理信息数字孪生来编程，但输出功率不能确定已实现的相位，而该相位决定不同输入光如何干涉；因此需要在不额外测量相位、不增加片外光学系统的情况下获得相位校准模型。
AI.method: 训练仅基于强度的数字孪生，使其预测已编程变换的规范不变相位，并利用该预测来编程相位；在12×12网格上，由网格自身形成的干涉协议测量相位，比较从随机起点出发的仅强度编程与相位感知编程，并测试最大10×10的子块；在相干输入下用片上Butler矩阵验证编程相位对输出的影响。摘要未提供具体网络结构、训练数据量及保真度的详细定义。
AI.result: 在12×12网格上，仅强度编程与相位感知编程达到相同的强度保真度，但相位保真度分别为0.690和0.996，且与数字孪生预测一致；该预测在最大10×10的子块上仍成立；在相干输入下，相位感知编程将片上Butler矩阵的到达方向误差从29度降低到2.0度。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭功率测量即可获得相位校准的网格模型，训练中不需要相位数据，也不需要芯片之外的光学测量；数字孪生对规范不变相位的预测可用于相位编程并改善相干输出性能。

title: Fourier-Transform Photothermal Spectroscopy with Transient-Lens Detection
summary: We demonstrate Fourier-transform photothermal spectroscopy using broadband supercontinuum excitation and transient-lens detection. The output of a Ti:sapphire oscillator is broadened in a photonic crystal fiber to generate the supercontinuum pump, which is converted into a phase-stable pulse pair with a controllable femtosecond delay using a birefringent interferometer. The absorption-induced heating from the pump generates a transient thermal lens in the sample, which is detected as a function of delay by an off-resonant 800 nm photothermal probe beam. Fourier transform of the interferometric photothermal response yields a frequency-domain signal corresponding to the sample absorptance spectrum weighted by the pump spectrum. After division by the measured pump spectrum, the reconstructed photothermal spectrum is compared with a direct frequency-domain linear absorption measurement to evaluate the accuracy of the reconstruction. This method combines Fourier-transform broadband excitation with thermal-lens readout, allowing broadband linear absorption spectra to be obtained from pump-induced refractive-index changes rather than from transmitted excitation intensity. We demonstrate the method on phloxine B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并演示了一种傅里叶变换光热光谱术：以宽带超连续谱为泵浦、以瞬态热透镜为探测，并在 phloxine B 上验证了光谱重建。
AI.motivation: 旨在将傅里叶变换宽带激发与热透镜读出相结合，通过泵浦诱导的折射率变化而非透射激发光强度来获取宽带线性吸收光谱。
AI.method: 将 Ti:sapphire 振荡器输出在光子晶体光纤中展宽，产生超连续谱泵浦；用双折射干涉仪将其转换为相位稳定、飞秒延迟可控的脉冲对。样品吸收泵浦后升温并形成瞬态热透镜，用非共振 800 nm 光热探测光束测量该热透镜随延迟的变化。对干涉式光热响应做傅里叶变换，得到由样品吸收率光谱与泵浦光谱加权对应的频域信号；再除以实测泵浦光谱重建光热光谱，并与直接频域线性吸收测量比较以评估重建精度。
AI.result: 获得了干涉式光热响应的频域信号，并完成泵浦光谱归一化后的光热光谱重建；重建结果与直接频域线性吸收测量进行了比较，并在 phloxine B 上演示了该方法。摘要未提供重建误差、光谱范围或灵敏度等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该方法结合了傅里叶变换宽带激发与热透镜读出，可基于泵浦诱导的折射率变化而非透射激发强度获得宽带线性吸收光谱，并在 phloxine B 上得到实验演示。

title: Minimum Effective-Susceptibility Bounds for Arbitrary Polarization Transformations in Metasurfaces
summary: Metasurfaces are increasingly employed for sophisticated polarization transformations, including general unitary and nonunitary Jones operations. Despite substantial advances in analytical synthesis methods, inverse design of these transformations remains challenging. Here, we show that the particular mathematical structure of Jones polarization transformations makes optimal effective-susceptibility synthesis analytically tractable within the generalized sheet transition condition (GSTC) framework. For reciprocal, lossless dipolar metasurfaces, we establish exact feasibility and global minimum attainment, and derive sharp effective-susceptibility bounds for representative unitary and nonunitary transformations. We identify when magnetoelectric coupling lowers the minimum susceptibility, when it offers no resource advantage, and how the required material response depends on the prescribed polarization transformation. Applications to polarization rotations, tunable compensators, and polarization-state separation, including unambiguous discrimination, demonstrate sharp physical limits and material-resource trade-offs. These results provide geometry-independent theoretical benchmarks that can guide numerical inverse design and the selection of metasurface architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文表明，在广义片层跃迁条件（GSTC）框架下，Jones极化变换的数学结构使最优有效磁化率综合可以解析求解；针对互易、无损的偶极超表面，论文建立了精确可行性与全局最小值，并推导出尖锐的有效磁化率边界。
AI.motivation: 超表面已广泛用于复杂极化变换，包括一般酉和非酉Jones操作；尽管解析综合方法已有显著进展，这类变换的逆向设计仍然困难。作者希望利用Jones极化变换的特殊数学结构，获得可解析处理的最优有效磁化率综合方法，并提供与几何无关的理论基准。
AI.method: 在GSTC框架内开展最优有效磁化率解析综合：利用Jones极化变换的数学结构，针对互易、无损偶极超表面建立精确可行性和全局最小值，推导代表性酉与非酉变换的尖锐有效磁化率边界，并分析磁电耦合对最小磁化率的影响。
AI.result: 论文建立了精确可行性与全局最小值的可达性，给出了代表性酉和非酉极化变换的尖锐有效磁化率边界；识别了磁电耦合何时降低最小磁化率、何时不带来资源优势和所需材料响应如何依赖 prescribed polarization transformation；在极化旋转、可调补偿器和极化态分离（包括无歧义判别）等应用中展示了尖锐物理极限与材料资源权衡。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果提供了与几何无关的理论基准，可指导数值逆向设计和超表面架构选择。

title: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography Using Deep Learning-Assisted Amplitude Estimation
summary: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography (GODT) enables the non-invasive reconstruction of a spatial derivative of the 3D sample's refractive index distribution, providing enhanced sensitivity to subtle refractive index variations through gradient-based contrast. Implemented using lateral shearing interferometry (LSI), GODT benefits from a common-path architecture that provides environmental stability and high signal-to-noise ratio measurements. Unlike conventional optical diffraction tomography (ODT), which requires numerical integration of LSI-derived phase gradients to recover the object phase, GODT enables direct tomographic reconstruction from the LSI data. Notably, GODT requires derivatives of both the phase and amplitude of the object fields as input. While the phase derivative can be readily extracted from LSI data, the amplitude gradient cannot be directly retrieved. Thus, in the original GODT formulation, the amplitude gradient was assumed to be negligible, limiting the accuracy of the resulting 3D reconstruction. In this work, we introduce amplitude-informed GODT (AI-GODT), which employs physics-informed supervised deep learning to estimate the missing amplitude gradient based on accessible LSI data, specifically the fringe modulation. The proposed approach, applying a ResNet architecture and training on computer-generated data, is validated through numerical simulation and experimental measurements of both a well-characterized test object and primary neuronal cell culture, demonstrating the network's ability to generalize to diverse samples. We show that incorporation of the recovered amplitude gradient into the GODT reconstruction pipeline improves the 3D reconstruction quality, especially in its out-of-focus regions. The software and datasets are openly available to facilitate reproducibility and further development.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出幅度信息引导的GODT（AI-GODT）：利用物理信息监督的深度学习，从横向剪切干涉（LSI）数据中的条纹调制估计GODT原先缺失的振幅梯度，并将其引入三维重建流程；数值仿真和实验均显示重建质量提升，尤其离焦区域。
AI.motivation: GODT可非侵入地重建样品折射率分布的空间导数，对细微折射率变化更敏感；基于LSI的GODT具有共路结构带来的环境稳定性和高信噪比，并可直接从LSI数据做层析重建，无需像常规ODT那样数值积分相位梯度。但GODT需要相位和振幅两者的导数作为输入，LSI可直接获得相位导数，振幅梯度却无法直接获取；原始GODT假设振幅梯度可忽略，从而限制了三维重建精度。
AI.method: 提出AI-GODT，采用ResNet架构和物理信息监督的深度学习，在计算机生成数据上训练，以可获取的LSI数据（特别是条纹调制）为输入估计缺失的振幅梯度，并将恢复的振幅梯度纳入GODT重建流程；通过数值仿真、对表征良好的测试对象以及原代神经元细胞培养的实验测量进行验证。
AI.result: 结果表明，所训练网络能够泛化到不同样品；将恢复的振幅梯度加入GODT重建流程后可提升三维重建质量，尤其在离焦区域。验证涵盖数值仿真和实验测量；摘要未提供具体定量评价指标。
AI.conclusion: AI-GODT通过深度学习补偿GODT中缺失的振幅梯度，改善了三维重建质量，并展示了向多样样品推广的潜力；软件和数据集已公开以促进可复现性和后续开发。摘要未给出软件与数据集的具体获取信息。

title: Ferroionic CuCrP2S6 Integrated Silicon Photonics for Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Neuromorphic photonic computing calls for optical states that combine stimulus accumulation, spontaneous relaxation, and nonvolatile state retention without continuous power dissipation. Here, we demonstrate a ferroionic photonic platform by integrating layered van der Waals CuCrP2S6 onto silicon microring resonators using a back-end integration process. Electrical pulsing produces unidirectional blue shifts in the optical resonance, consistent with field-driven redistribution of mobile Cu ions and giving rise to a history-dependent optical response. The resulting optical state is strongly pulse dependent, exhibiting both volatile and nonvolatile components. A short 20-pulse excitation produces an initial 70 pm resonance shift that relaxes toward baseline within approximately 60 s, with a volatile relaxation time constant of 27-29 s. In contrast, after 1000 pulses, an initial 0.27 nm resonance shift relaxes to a persistent 0.13 nm nonvolatile state that is retained for at least 24 h. Repeated 6 V electrical pulses produce a progressive resonance shift over 1000 cycles, demonstrating cumulative optical integration. A fixed-wavelength readout converts the accumulated resonance shift into a thresholded optical response, with the normalized transmission remaining above the selected threshold through 600 pulses and falling below it at the 800-pulse state. These dynamics realize the basis for a leaky integrate-and-fire photonic neuron, where the pulse-dependent ionic response provides integration, spontaneous relaxation supplies a passive leak, persistent states provide nonvolatile memory, and fixed-wavelength readout provides an optical threshold response.

AI.tldr: 该文将层状范德华CuCrP2S6集成到硅微环谐振器上，构建铁离子光子平台；电脉冲驱动Cu离子重新分布，产生兼具易失与非易失成分的历史依赖光响应，并实现累积积分、自发弛豫、非易失保持及固定波长阈值读出，从而验证泄漏积分-发放光子神经元的基本动力学。
AI.motivation: 神经形态光子计算需要同时具备刺激累积、自发弛豫和非易失状态保持，且不依赖持续功耗的光学状态。现有平台难以在同一器件中融合这些特性，因此作者寻求基于铁离子材料与硅光子谐振器的可集成方案。
AI.method: 采用后端集成工艺，将层状范德华CuCrP2S6集成到硅微环谐振器上，形成铁离子光子平台；通过电脉冲激励产生光学谐振单向蓝移，并表征脉冲历史依赖的易失/非易失光状态、重复脉冲累积响应以及固定波长读出下的阈值化透射响应。摘要未提供材料厚度、器件尺寸、具体功耗及制备良率等细节。
AI.result: 电脉冲引起与场驱动移动Cu离子再分布一致的单向蓝移。短脉冲序列（20个脉冲）产生初始70 pm谐振位移，并在约60 s内向基线弛豫，易失弛豫时间常数为27–29 s；1000个脉冲后初始0.27 nm位移弛豫至持久0.13 nm非易失状态，至少保持24 h。6 V重复脉冲在1000个周期内产生渐进谐振位移，显示累积光学积分。固定波长读出将累积位移转换为阈值响应：归一化透射在600个脉冲时仍高于所选阈值，在800个脉冲状态下降至阈值以下。
AI.conclusion: 该铁离子光子平台实现了脉冲依赖的离子响应提供积分、自发弛豫提供无源泄漏、持久状态提供非易失记忆、固定波长读出提供光学阈值响应，构成了泄漏积分-发放光子神经元的基本动力学基础。摘要未提供完整神经元网络级验证或系统级性能比较。

title: Transport Layer-Driven Optimization of Color and Efficiency in TADF OLEDs for Large-Area Applications
summary: Balancing structural simplicity with high efficiency is crucial for practical applications of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), especially in large-area lighting devices. Optimizing the charge-transport layers in multilayer OLEDs controls the recombination zone within the emissive layer, thereby enhancing the device's performance. Herein, we experimentally and computationally investigate how the thicknesses of the electron and hole transport layers affect the performance of orange-red thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) OLEDs. Using a TADF emitter, 2-[4-(diphenylamino)phenyl]-10,10-dioxide-9H-thioxanthen-9-one (TXO-TPA), at 10 wt\% concentration in 4,4-Bis(N-carbazolyl)-1,1-biphenyl (CBP) host, we achieve a maximum external quantum efficiency ($η_{EQE}$) of 20.86\% and a peak luminance of 32,800 cd m$^{-2}$. Using a combination of drift-diffusion and optical simulations, we reveal how variations in hole- and electron-transport-layer thicknesses modulate the charge-carrier balance and shift the recombination zone within the emissive layer. This tuning not only optimizes exciton formation but also enables color tuning from green to red without altering the emissive material. Our findings highlight the critical role of transport layer engineering in achieving efficient, color-controlled OLEDs with simplified architectures. Furthermore, we successfully demonstrate a large-area OLED device (~20 cm$^{2}$), achieving an impressive $η_{EQE}$ of 17\%, underscoring the scalability and practicality of our approach for general lighting applications.

title: Existence of single-resonance parametric bound states in the continuum: System of Schrödinger equations
summary: A bound state in the continuum (BIC) is an eigenmode of a linear wave system with its eigen-frequency embedded in the radiation continuum of scattering states. At the frequency of a BIC, scattering problems with given incident waves from infinity lose uniqueness. Due to their close connection with strong resonance effects, BICs have found many useful applications in classical and quantum wave systems. Existence theories of BICs have been established for some cases involving the so-called symmetry-protected BICs, Friedrich-Wintgen BICs, and Fabry-Perot BICs. The single-resonance parametric BICs (srp-BICs) are another important class of BICs. Such a BIC emerges from a single resonant state through tuning a real parameter. Using a simple system of two one-dimensional Schrödinger equations, we demonstrate the formation of srp-BICs and establish a rigorous existence theory.

AI.tldr: 该文研究单共振参数型连续谱束缚态（srp-BIC），在由两个一维薛定谔方程构成的简单系统中展示其形成机制，并建立严格的存在性理论。
AI.motivation: BIC因与强共振效应密切相关而在经典和量子波系统中具有重要应用；已有严格存在性理论主要涉及对称保护型BIC、Friedrich-Wintgen BIC和Fabry-Perot BIC，而srp-BIC作为另一类重要BIC，需要严格的 existence theory 支撑。
AI.method: 采用由两个一维薛定谔方程组成的简单系统，通过调节一个实参数，使单个共振态形成srp-BIC，并据此建立严格的存在性理论。
AI.result: 在该简单系统中展示了srp-BIC的形成，并建立了srp-BIC的严格存在性理论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为单共振参数型BIC提供了严格的理论基础，表明其可在简单一维薛定谔系统中由单共振态经实参数调节形成；摘要未给出具体数值结果或实验验证。

title: Carrier relaxation confines the Bogdanov--Takens degeneracy of an optically injected semiconductor laser
summary: Optically injected semiconductor lasers are forced nonlinear oscillators whose locking boundaries are organized by codimension-two points. We ask which property of the carrier balance permits or forbids a Bogdanov--Takens (BT) point in the standard three-dimensional rate equations. Taking the carrier inversion $n$ as distinguished observable, the rate that enters the spectral conditions is the slope of the gain--loss balance, $ξ=\partial\dot n/\partial n=-2Γ/κ$, where $Γ$ is the damping of the relaxation oscillation and $κ=1+2Bn$ the normalized stimulated-emission factor. The two BT conditions become affine in $ξ$ and imply the exact sum rule $K^{2}=I[1-(1+κ)I]$ between injection amplitude $K$ and intracavity intensity $I$. The product of the two relaxation eigenvalues that survive at a saddle-node is bounded below by $1-16Γ^{2}$, so that no BT point exists for $Γ<1/4$, whatever $B$, the linewidth enhancement factor, the injection strength and the detuning; below this barrier every contact between Hopf and saddle-node curves is a fold--Hopf point. For $B=0$ the barrier is completed to an exact existence criterion. We prove that the unfolding of a BT point by injection strength and detuning is transversal if and only if two explicit curves cross transversally in the plane of locked states; for $B=0$ this is a simple root of an explicit function, and transversality fails exactly at the existence threshold. Two BT points at $Γ=1/2$, $α=2$ are verified to be generic, and the contacts between Hopf and saddle-node curves are classified into fold--Hopf, BT and nilpotent triple-zero points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究标准三维光学注入半导体激光器速率方程中 Bogdanov–Takens（BT）点的存在性与展开性质，指出载流子平衡中增益—损耗斜率 ξ=-2Γ/κ 及阻尼 Γ 构成关键限制：Γ<1/4 时不存在 BT 点，并给出 B=0 时的精确判据与横截性条件。
AI.motivation: 光学注入半导体激光器是被迫非线性振子，其锁定边界由余维二点组织；作者要回答标准三维速率方程中载流子平衡的哪一性质允许或禁止 Bogdanov–Takens 点。
AI.method: 以载流子反转 n 为区分观测量，将谱条件中的速率取为增益—损耗平衡斜率 ξ=∂ṅ/∂n=-2Γ/κ，其中 Γ 为弛豫振荡阻尼、κ=1+2Bn 为归一化受激发射因子；把两个 BT 条件化为关于 ξ 的仿射条件并导出注入幅度 K 与腔内强度 I 的精确求和规则 K²=I[1-(1+κ)I]；分析鞍结处剩余两个弛豫特征值的乘积下界 1-16Γ²；对 B=0 补全精确存在判据；并通过锁定态平面中两条显式曲线的横截相交证明 BT 点由注入强度和失谐展开的横截性。
AI.result: 得到不存在 BT 点的屏障：当 Γ<1/4 时，无论 B、线宽增强因子、注入强度和失谐如何，均无 BT 点，Hopf 与鞍结曲线之间的接触均为折叠–Hopf 点；B=0 时给出精确存在判据；证明 BT 点展开横截当且仅当两条显式曲线在锁定态平面横截相交，B=0 时等价于某显式函数的简单根，且横截性恰在存在阈值处失效；在 Γ=1/2、α=2 处验证两个 BT 点为 generic，并将 Hopf 与鞍结曲线的接触分类为折叠–Hopf、BT 和幂零三重零点。
AI.conclusion: 载流子平衡决定的增益—损耗斜率与弛豫振荡阻尼设定了 BT 点存在性的根本约束；Γ<1/4 排除 BT 点，B=0 时存在性可精确判定，BT 点的横截展开可由锁定态平面中显式曲线的横截相交刻画，且相关退化接触可系统分类。

title: Deep-learning-enabled rapid spatially multiplexed wavefront sensing with a thin diffuser
summary: Conventional wavefront sensing typically measures aberrations along a single guide-star direction, limiting the correction of field-dependent aberrations over a wide field of view. Spatial multiplexing with a thin diffuser enables simultaneous measurements across multiple isoplanatic patches, but the computational cost of reconstruction makes it difficult to track changing aberrations. We propose a deep-learning approach that combines recurrent all-pairs field transforms for displacement estimation with Zernike coefficient regression. Experimental results show that the method accurately reconstructs multiple wavefronts from a single speckle pattern and reduces three-channel reconstruction time from 2801.6 ms with conventional digital image correlation (DIC) to 23.1 ms. The reconstructed wavefronts agreed more closely with sequential single-channel references than those obtained by multiplexed DIC, and simulations showed that Zernike regression was more robust to noise than direct gradient integration. These results suggest a path toward dynamic wide-field aberration sensing and high-speed adaptive optics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种将循环全对场变换位移估计与Zernike系数回归相结合的深度学习方法，用于从单幅散斑图同时重建多个波前；实验显示三通道重建时间由DIC的2801.6 ms降至23.1 ms，且重建波前更接近顺序单通道参考。
AI.motivation: 传统波前传感通常沿单一导星方向测量像差，难以在大视场内校正随视场变化的像差；薄扩散器空间复用虽可同时测量多个等晕区，但重建计算成本高，难以跟踪变化像差。
AI.method: 将用于位移估计的循环全对场变换（recurrent all-pairs field transforms）与Zernike系数回归相结合，构建深度学习波前重建方法，从单幅散斑图案重建多个波前。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能从单幅散斑图准确重建多个波前，并将三通道重建时间从传统数字图像相关（DIC）的2801.6 ms缩短至23.1 ms；重建波前与顺序单通道参考的一致性优于复用DIC，仿真显示Zernike回归比直接梯度积分对噪声更稳健。

title: Statistical analysis of crossing beam speckle fields
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to Physical Review E
summary: Building on the statistical analysis of single beam speckles, this paper develops a statistical description of speckle fields formed by crossing laser beams. A formal definition of individual speckles and their domains allows us to quantify the effective size and abundance of speckles. For two crossing beams, the effective speckle size is derived from the local curvature of the intensity field, and the expected speckle abundance is found asymptotically with the Kac-Rice formula. Monte Carlo simulations of speckle abundance show excellent agreement with the theoretical abundance formula. The two beam speckle analysis is then applied to a symmetric quad beam configuration motivated by polarization smoothing and demonstrates that increasing the separation between beams reduces expected stimulated Brillouin scattering reflectivity from saturated speckles. The statistical model is then extended to an arbitrary number of beams using a coordinate free formulation to obtain the spectral density of laser driven electron density fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 该文将单光束散斑统计推广到交叉激光束散斑场，给出散斑及其域的形式化定义、有效尺寸与丰度的统计描述，并用蒙特卡洛模拟验证；随后应用于四光束偏振平滑构型并扩展到任意光束数，以获得激光驱动电子密度涨落的谱密度。
AI.motivation: 既有工作主要分析单光束散斑，本文旨在建立交叉激光束所形成散斑场的统计描述，量化散斑的有效尺寸和丰度，并用于评估偏振平滑四光束构型中的受激布里渊散射反射率及激光驱动电子密度涨落。
AI.method: 形式化定义单个散斑及其域；对两束交叉光，由强度场的局部曲率推导有效散斑尺寸，并用Kac-Rice公式渐近求得期望散斑丰度；通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验丰度公式；将两光束分析用于对称四光束构型，并采用无坐标表述推广到任意光束数，得到激光驱动电子密度涨落的谱密度。
AI.result: 两光束情形下，有效散斑尺寸由强度场局部曲率给出，期望散斑丰度由Kac-Rice公式渐近确定，蒙特卡洛模拟与理论丰度公式高度一致；四光束算例表明增大光束间距可降低由饱和散斑引起的期望受激布里渊散射反射率；任意光束数下可获得激光驱动电子密度涨落的谱密度。

title: Transition Path Sampling for Rare Events in Non-Markovian Open Quantum Systems
comment: Letter: 6 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material: 14 pages, 5 figures. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24538275
summary: Rare transitions govern the dynamics of many open quantum systems, but their probabilities and rates are difficult to calculate. Transition path sampling (TPS) of quantum systems has so far been limited to Markovian, perturbative descriptions. Here, we formulate TPS for non-Markovian quantum state diffusion, which is exact for Gaussian baths, extending it to non-Markovian and strongly coupled open quantum systems. For normal-to-superradiant tunneling in the unbalanced open Dicke model, we determine probabilities down to $10^{-8}$ and rates beyond the reach of brute force.

AI.tldr: 本文为非马尔可夫量子态扩散建立了过渡路径采样方法，并将其用于强耦合开放量子系统中的稀有跃迁计算。
AI.motivation: 稀有跃迁控制许多开放量子系统的动力学，但其概率和速率难以计算；此前的量子过渡路径采样仅限于马尔可夫、微扰描述。
AI.method: 作者为非马尔可夫量子态扩散构建过渡路径采样（TPS），该方法对高斯浴是精确的，从而将TPS推广到非马尔可夫且强耦合的开放量子系统；随后将其应用于非平衡开放Dicke模型中的正常态—超辐射隧穿。
AI.result: 在非平衡开放Dicke模型中，作者计算了低至$10^{-8}$的跃迁概率，并获得了暴力计算无法触及的跃迁速率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将量子过渡路径采样扩展到非马尔可夫、强耦合开放量子系统，并证明其能够有效刻画极稀有跃迁的概率与速率。

title: Why do single photons produce interference fringes? The phase of a mode and the phase of a state
comment: 60 pages, 9 figures. Submission to SciPost Physics Lecture Notes
summary: If the phase of a photon-number state is completely undetermined, how can single photons, sent one at a time through a two-slit apparatus, build up interference fringes? These lecture notes answer this question from first principles. Starting from Maxwell's equations, we expand the field in vector modes, quantize it, and introduce the quantity measured by a photodetector. We then show that the word ``phase'' refers to two different things: the phase of a mode, fixed by the optical setup, and the phase of the quantum state that excites the mode. Only the first determines the fringes. All calculations are given in full, and problems with solutions are included.

AI.tldr: 该讲义从第一性原理解释：即使光子数态的相位完全不确定，单光子逐一通过双缝仍能形成干涉条纹；关键在于区分模式相位与量子态相位，只有模式相位决定条纹。
AI.motivation: 回答一个基础困惑：当光子数态的相位完全未定时，单光子逐一通过双缝装置为何仍能累积出干涉条纹。
AI.method: 从麦克斯韦方程出发，将场按矢量模式展开并量子化，引入光电探测器所测量的物理量；随后区分两种“相位”——由光学装置固定的模式相位，以及激发该模式的量子态相位；给出完整计算并附有带解答的习题。
AI.result: 分析表明，干涉条纹只由模式相位决定，而不由量子态相位决定；摘要未提供具体实验参数或定量结果。
AI.conclusion: “相位”一词指代两个不同概念，混淆二者会导致上述困惑；单光子干涉条纹可由光学模式相位解释。该讲义提供完整推导和习题解答，属于教学性阐述。

title: A bright source of high-dimensional spatially entangled photon pairs based on beam-like Type-II SPDC
summary: Bright sources of high-dimensional spatially entangled photon pairs are increasingly required for the rapid advancement of quantum technologies. However, simultaneously achieving high brightness and high-dimensional spatial entanglement through spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate a bright source of high-dimensional spatially entangled photon pairs using beam-like Type-II SPDC in a $β$-barium borate crystal. Compared with a conventional collinear Type-I source, it exhibits a $\sim$1.56-fold enhancement in the detected single-photon count rate and a $\sim$1.45-fold enhancement in the coincidence count rate. Measurements of position correlations and momentum anti-correlations certify at least 62-dimensional spatial entanglement within a 121-dimensional basis. These correlations are further exploited to demonstrate quantum imaging in both the position and momentum domains. These characteristics make the source a practical resource for high-dimensional photonic quantum technologies.

AI.motivation: 量子技术快速发展需要亮的高维空间纠缠光子对源，但通过自发参量下转换同时实现高亮度和高维空间纠缠仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用β-硼酸钡晶体中的束状Type-II自发参量下转换制备高维空间纠缠光子对，并与传统共线Type-I源进行比较；通过测量位置相关和动量反相关认证空间纠缠维度，并利用这些相关性进行量子成像。

title: When Malus' Law Meets the Wigner-Bell Inequality: Violation by Nonseparable Classical Light
summary: Bell-type inequalities are commonly associated with quantum nonlocality, yet their mathematical structure also reflects more general constraints on the joint probability distributions assigned to measurements performed in different contexts. Here we examine this distinction through the Wigner--Bell inequality using a classical optical field with two nonseparable degrees of freedom. Starting from a subsystem response-factorization assumption, we derive a Wigner-type probability bound requiring the pairwise measurement statistics to be compatible with a single nonnegative global joint distribution. For a classically nonseparable optical field, the corresponding joint probabilities are represented directly by normalized joint intensities and obey Malus' law. We show that these Malus-law probabilities violate the Wigner--Bell bound over a finite range of analyzer settings. The violation does not imply spatial nonlocality or a failure of classical electrodynamics. Rather, it demonstrates the incompatibility of context-dependent optical projection statistics with the global probability assignment underlying the Wigner construction. We further derive an extended Wigner-Bell bound for general imperfect correlations and propose an interferometric experiment for reconstructing the required joint probabilities from intensity measurements. These results provide a transparent optical realization of the probabilistic structure behind Bell-type inequalities and help distinguish consequences of Hilbert-space structure, nonseparability, and measurement context from those specifically associated with quantum nonlocality.

AI.tldr: 本文用具有两个不可分离自由度的经典光场检验Wigner--Bell不等式，表明Malus定律下的联合强度概率可在有限分析器设置范围内违反该界，而这种违反源于测量情境相关的投影统计与全局非负联合概率分配不相容，并不代表空间非局域性或经典电动力学失效。
AI.motivation: Bell型不等式通常与量子非局域性联系，但其数学结构也反映不同测量情境下联合概率分布的一般约束。作者希望借助经典光学体系区分Hilbert空间结构、不可分离性和测量情境所导致的后果与真正由量子非局域性带来的后果。
AI.method: 从子系统响应因子化假设出发，推导要求成对测量统计可由单一非负全局联合分布描述的Wigner型概率界；对经典不可分离光场，用归一化联合强度和Malus定律表示相应联合概率，并在有限分析器设置范围内检验是否违反该界。文中还推导了适用于一般非理想关联的扩展Wigner--Bell界，并提出通过强度测量重建所需联合概率的干涉实验方案。
AI.result: 经典不可分离光场的Malus定律联合概率会在有限分析器设置范围内违反Wigner--Bell界。该违反不意味着空间非局域性，也不意味着经典电动力学失效，而是说明情境相关的光学投影统计与Wigner构造所依赖的全局概率分配不相容。作者还给出了非理想关联下的扩展界和可重建联合概率的干涉测量方案。
